job.title: Enterprise Sales Manager - Common Room
job.description:
VP of Enterprise SalesWhat You Can Expect

What You Can Expect

As Enterprise Sales Manager, you will own the number for a team of Account Executives focused on Zoom's largest and most strategic prospects, setting the operating rhythm that makes results predictable quarter over quarter. Day to day, you will coach deals at every stage, from early qualification through late-stage executive alignment and procurement navigation, while building the playbooks and cadences that multiply your team's effectiveness. You will partner closely with SDRs, Marketing, Solutions Engineering, Sales Ops, and Customer Success to sharpen how the team generates and converts pipeline. Candidates without prior formal people-management titles but with a strong enterprise sales track record and a natural instinct for coaching others are encouraged to apply.


About the Team

Zoom's UpMarket Sales team drives growth by connecting mid-to-large enterprises with Zoom Workplace, Zoom Contact Center, and Zoom's broader communications platform. The team plays a central role in expanding Zoom's footprint across complex, high-value accounts, working in close partnership with Solutions Engineering, Marketing, and Customer Success to deliver measurable outcomes. Their results directly shape how Zoom deepens relationships with some of its most strategically important customers.


Responsibilities

  • Lead enterprise deal strategy across the team: coach AEs on account planning, multi-threading, and buying committee mapping, applying MEDDPICC or equivalent qualification frameworks to pressure-test pain, decision process, and competition.
  • Drive hands-on involvement in late-stage deals, including executive alignment, mutual action plans, pricing and negotiation, and navigation of procurement, legal, and security reviews.
  • Set pipeline targets by rep and build repeatable outbound and account-based plays with SDRs, Marketing, and Solutions Engineering, using signal-driven prioritization to focus the team where it matters most.
  • Inspect pipeline quality weekly, holding the team accountable to coverage goals, stage hygiene, next steps, close dates, and conversion metrics across each stage.
  • Own and call the team forecast with confidence each week, backed by deal-level evidence and current CRM data.
  • Run a disciplined operating cadence including weekly 1:1s, pipeline and forecast reviews, deal reviews, and quarterly business reviews.
  • Coach AEs through live deal work, call reviews, and role plays, converting individual wins into scalable team playbooks and raising the collective bar for ownership.
  • Partner on hiring, onboarding, and ramp for new AEs, setting a high bar for performance and delivering direct, timely feedback.
  • Collaborate with Sales Ops, Marketing, Product, and Customer Success to reduce friction for the team and customers, and bring field insights on wins, losses, and competitive dynamics back to leadership.

What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years of quota-carrying mid-market or enterprise B2B SaaS sales with a consistent record of meeting or exceeding targets, including complex, multi-stakeholder deals with long cycles and six-figure ACVs.
  • Deep enterprise deal strategy experience: you can articulate exactly why deals were won or lost and have coached others through comparable complexity.
  • Operational rigor with pipeline management, CRM hygiene, and forecasting: you know your numbers and forecast within a tight margin of where you land.
  • Demonstrated coaching ability through informal mentorship, rep onboarding, or deal strategy leadership, with a genuine investment in making others better.
  • Clear, direct communication style that earns credibility with VP- and C-level buyers and holds a team accountable to high standards.
  • Comfort with ambiguity and the pace of a high-growth environment, with a self-directed ownership mindset.
  • Familiarity with enterprise qualification frameworks such as MEDDPICC or Command of the Message; experience selling to GTM, RevOps, or data-driven buyers is a plus.

Salary Range or On Target Earnings:

Minimum:

$200,700.00

Maximum:

$447,900.00



In addition to the base salary and/or OTE listed Zoom has a Total Direct Compensation philosophy that takes into consideration; base salary, bonus and equity value.

Note: Starting pay will be based on a number of factors and commensurate with qualifications & experience.

We also have a location based compensation structure;  there may be a different range for candidates in this and other locations

job.title: Global Program Manager
job.description:
About the Role


At Zoom, we're on a mission to make connections meaningful. As a Global Program Manager for our Services Partner Program, you'll be at the heart of that mission — owning, evolving, and scaling a program that's already making an impact. This isn't a build-from-scratch role. It's a sharpen, elevate, and accelerate role.


You'll sit within Zoom's Global Partner Program team and work alongside a dynamic cross-functional group spanning channel account management, channel sales engineering, channel operations, and professional services. If you're energized by optimization over creation, thrive in complexity, and love leaving things better than you found them — this role was built for you.


What You'll Do


  • Own and evolve Zoom's Services Partner Program — driving strategic updates that keep it competitive, relevant, and scalable.
  • Identify gaps, trends, and optimization opportunities within the current program and implement meaningful improvements.
  • Partner with global enablement teams to ensure Zoom Channel Teams and Partners are fully equipped to leverage the program effectively.
  • Maintain deep, ongoing engagement with Zoom Partners to stay connected to their business needs and surface insights that shape program direction.
  • Manage partner issues and escalations end-to-end — owning corrective action plans and driving them through to resolution.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with Professional Services, Channel Sales Engineering, IT, Finance, Legal, Procurement, HR, and Compliance to support program execution and governance.
  • Develop and maintain executive-ready reporting, insights, and program recommendations that inform strategic decisions.
  • Establish, monitor, and report on KPIs that reflect program health, partner performance, and overall business impact.

What We're Looking For


  • 6–10+ years of experience working for or with Partners in a channel or alliance capacity.
  • 3+ years of experience building or managing partner programs.
  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Operations, Management, or a related field.
  • Strong interpersonal and team-building skills with the ability to influence and drive change across functional and business boundaries.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, paired with tactful diplomacy in complexstakeholder environments.
  • Strong financial and operational acumen — you're comfortable rolling up your sleeves and getting into the details.


Bonus Points If You Have


  • Experience building or owning a Partner Services Program.
  • Background in Professional Services sales, consulting, or delivery.

job.title: Customer Advocacy Program Manager, Zoom Contact Center
job.description:
What You Can Expect

As the dedicated Customer Advocacy Program Manager for Zoom Contact Center, you will own the end-to-end customer advocacy lifecycle for Zoom's CX product line, turning customer voices into a strategic engine that drives market proof, AI visibility, and competitive differentiation. Working closely with Product Marketing, GTM, and Customer Success teams, you will build and manage a pipeline of customer stories, secure references for analyst evaluations, lead the always-on reviews program across Gartner Peer Insights, TrustRadius, and G2, and steward the CX Council as a vehicle for deepening long-term advocate relationships. This role sits at a meaningful intersection of strategy and execution, requiring someone equally comfortable shaping the advocacy roadmap for a high-growth product line and rolling up their sleeves to source the next customer reference. If you are energized by the full advocacy lifecycle and want to make the customer voice a core pillar of how Zoom Contact Center goes to market, this is the role for you.


About the Team

The Customer Advocacy team is part of Zoom's broader Content and Marketing organization, responsible for building the customer evidence that drives awareness, consideration, and pipeline across Zoom's product portfolio. We work at the intersection of customer relationships, product marketing, and go-to-market strategy, turning real customer experiences into stories, references, reviews, and council engagements that build trust in the market. Our work directly supports analyst evaluations, demand generation, and Zoom's AI visibility across the modern buyer journey.


Responsibilities

  • Own and execute a pipeline of Zoom Contact Center customer stories in video and written formats for Zoom.com, media, and press opportunities, managing the full lifecycle from customer identification through final publication.
  • Identify and place customer speakers for CX-related owned and third-party events and webinars, matching the right advocates to the right moments across the marketing calendar.
  • Partner with Analyst Relations, Product Marketing, and GTM to identify and secure strong customer references for key analyst evaluations including Gartner, IDC, and Forrester, aligned to evaluation-specific product, vertical, and geography requirements.
  • Lead the always-on Zoom Contact Center reviews program across Gartner Peer Insights, TrustRadius, and G2, treating reviews as a strategic content engine and maximizing AEO/GEO visibility while surfacing opportunities for intent lead generation, comparison reports, and managed services.
  • Collaborate with Integrated Marketing, Product Marketing, and Content teams to leverage customer reviews and market reports for demand generation, content enablement, and scaled advocacy impact.
  • Lead the CX Council end to end, managing member communications, meeting scheduling, agendas, and content preparation in partnership with the CX Council Executive Sponsor and key product leaders, while cultivating council members into long-term advocates across the full advocacy program.
  • Partner with Customer Success and GTM teams to continuously identify, develop, and maintain a pipeline of customer advocates whose stories, references, and participation support core Zoom Contact Center messaging pillars, product capabilities, and target verticals.

What We're Looking For

  • 8+ years of B2B high-tech marketing experience in roles such as integrated marketing, campaigns, field marketing, or content, combined with 3-5 years of direct experience in Customer Advocacy, Customer Marketing, or Content.
  • Demonstrated experience managing customer advocacy programs and third-party review platforms including Gartner Peer Insights, G2, and TrustRadius, with the ability to operate reviews as a strategic, always-on content engine.
  • Superb customer-facing communication skills, with a demonstrated ability to earn customer trust, request participation with professionalism and care, and steward long-term advocate relationships.
  • Excellent organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple concurrent programs, stakeholders, and deadlines across a complex cross-functional environment.
  • Comfort with data, metrics, and target-setting, including experience managing toward stretch goals, reporting on program performance, and using data to prioritize advocacy investments.
  • Experience collaborating cross-functionally with Sales, Marketing, Product Marketing, Customer Success, and Analyst Relations teams, with a strong understanding of the B2B technology buyer journey and the role customer evidence plays in purchase decisions.
  • Knowledge of or experience in the Contact Center, CCaaS, or CX technology market; familiarity with AEO/GEO concepts and how customer evidence contributes to AI-driven search visibility is a plus.

$225,700.00

job.title: Program Manager, Customer Advocacy
job.description:
What You Can Expect

As Program Manager, Customer Advocacy, you will lead Zoom's end-to-end customer reviews strategy across Gartner Peer Insights, TrustRadius, and G2, building a sustainable, always-on program that transforms customer evidence into a strategic engine for market proof and competitive differentiation. This role sits at the intersection of customer advocacy, marketing strategy, and analyst relations, with direct responsibility for elevating the customer voice into AI visibility, marketing narratives, and sales enablement at scale. You will move Zoom's approach from episodic, award-driven solicitations to a strategic program that serves analyst evaluation cycles, supports AEO/GEO visibility, and feeds cross-functional marketing initiatives across content, demand generation, and social. For a strategist who is equally comfortable setting direction and executing in the details, this role offers the scope, visibility, and organizational impact to build something genuinely differentiated.


About the Team

The Content and Customer Advocacy team sits at the center of Zoom's marketing engine, shaping the stories, strategies, and digital experiences that connect Zoom's brand with its most important audiences. We own content strategy, editorial programs, customer advocacy, and the digital experience on zoom.com, working across Sales, Product Marketing, Integrated Marketing, and Analyst Relations to turn customer evidence into a competitive advantage. We are a high-impact, cross-functional team that stays relentlessly focused on measurable outcomes and business impact.


Responsibilities

  • Lead the end-to-end customer review strategy across Gartner Peer Insights, TrustRadius, and G2, shifting from episodic award-driven solicitations to a strategic, always-on program that drives market proof and competitive differentiation.
  • Own the customer review calendar, balancing continuous review generation across key product categories with strategic alignment to analyst evaluation periods and market priorities.
  • Prioritize AEO/GEO visibility of customer reviews to maximize AI citations, support core marketing narratives, and influence technology buyer evaluations across the dark funnel.
  • Manage Zoom's presence across all subscribed and non-subscribed review platforms, ensuring accuracy, completeness, and strategic positioning while tracking volume, quality, ratings, sentiment, and competitive standing.
  • Support key Analyst Relations market evaluations including Forrester Wave, IDC MarketScape, and Gartner Magic Quadrant with high-quality customer references, partnering with Product Marketing and AR to match references to specific product, industry, and geographic requirements.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with Sales, Content, Integrated Marketing, Social Media, and Digital teams to drive multi-channel promotion and consumption of customer reviews.
  • Partner with reviews vendors to shift relationships from tactical solicitation to a strategic content engine, leveraging comparison reports, customer story generation, and reference identification.
  • Surface growth opportunities by integrating customer reviews into internal AI search tools, identifying key strategic focus markets, and building organizational expertise across review platform capabilities including intent leads, content licensing, and emerging features.

What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years of B2B technology marketing experience in roles such as integrated marketing, campaigns, field marketing, or content, combined with 3-5 years of direct experience in customer advocacy, customer reviews management, or analyst relations.
  • Demonstrated experience managing third-party review platforms including Gartner Peer Insights, G2, and TrustRadius, with the ability to track and analyze volume, quality, ratings, sentiment, and competitive standing.
  • Excellent organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple concurrent programs, stakeholders, and deadlines across a complex cross-functional environment.
  • Superb customer-facing communication skills, with experience directing customer time and attention in ways that are respectful, strategic, and effective.
  • Comfort with data, metrics, and target-setting, including experience managing toward stretch goals and clearly reporting program performance to leadership.
  • Experience supporting analyst evaluations such as Forrester Wave, IDC MarketScape, and Gartner Magic Quadrant with customer references, and a strong understanding of the B2B technology buyer journey and the role customer evidence plays in purchase decisions.
  • Familiarity with AEO/GEO concepts, customer advocacy platforms, and reference management tools; background in SaaS, UCaaS, CCaaS, or enterprise technology marketing is a plus.

job.title: Technical Consultant
job.description:
Immigration sponsorship is not available for this position

What You Can Expect


You are the anchor of long-term technical success for some of Zoom's most complex enterprise contact center deployments. You own the ongoing technical relationship across a portfolio of MSO accounts running Zoom Contact Center and Zoom Virtual Agent, driving continuous optimization, resolving escalations, and ensuring customers extract measurable value from the platform. You work at the intersection of customer advocacy, platform expertise, and operational excellence, partnering closely with Engineering, Product, and Customer Success to move quickly on what matters most. Candidates without hands-on cloud contact center experience or conversational AI platform expertise will not be considered for this role.

About the Team


Zoom’s Managed Services Operations (MSO) team is the long-term success engine for Zoom’s enterprise and premier contact center customers. We stay engaged after implementation, ensuring complex Zoom Contact Center and Zoom Virtual Agent environments remain optimized, resilient, and aligned to each customer’s evolving business goals. Our team operates at the intersection of product, engineering, and customer success, and our work directly shapes how enterprise organizations experience and grow with Zoom’s contact center platform.


Responsibilities

  • Own the ongoing technical relationship for a portfolio of enterprise MSO accounts running Zoom Contact Center and Zoom Virtual Agent, serving as the primary technical advisor across configuration, optimization, and escalation management.
  • Lead recurring cadence calls, monthly and quarterly business reviews, and ad-hoc technical sessions with customer stakeholders, translating business objectives into actionable Zoom Contact Center and Zoom Virtual Agent strategies.
  • Execute day-two configurations including flow updates, queue management, skill-based routing, IVR modifications, and Zoom Virtual Agent conversation design changes across voice, chat, video, and SMS engagement channels.
  • Design and refine Zoom Virtual Agent bots, including intent training, NLP tuning, API and webhook integrations with platforms such as Salesforce and ServiceNow, and OAuth-based authentication flows.
  • Analyze call analytics dashboards and CX metrics to identify trends, surface quality issues, and recommend data-driven improvements aligned to each customer’s business outcomes.
  • Manage Tier 2/3 escalation triage for assigned accounts, coordinating with Zoom Support, Engineering, and Product teams to resolve critical incidents with defined timelines and thorough root-cause documentation.
  • Advocate internally for customer needs, driving feature requests, escalating product gaps, and maintaining awareness of platform releases and known issues that may affect customer environments.
  • Maintain detailed account documentation including meeting notes, configuration records, escalation logs, and runbooks, and contribute to team knowledge bases, playbooks, and AI-assisted automation tooling.
  • Partner with TAMs, CSMs, and Account Executives to deliver a unified customer experience, and actively participate in MSO Ops Weekly, team standups, and cross-functional syncs.


What We’re Looking For

  • 5+ years of hands-on experience with cloud contact center platforms, with Zoom Contact Center strongly preferred; equivalent experience with Genesys, NICE, or Five9 accepted.
  • Demonstrated experience with conversational AI and virtual agent platforms, including bot design, intent management, NLP configuration, and API integrations.
  • Strong command of contact center fundamentals: ACD, IVR/IVA, skill-based routing, workforce management concepts, and omnichannel engagement.
  • Working knowledge of REST APIs, OAuth 2.0, webhooks, JavaScript, and CRM/ITSM integrations including Salesforce and ServiceNow.
  • Proficiency in call analytics interpretation and CX dashboard analysis, with the ability to translate data into clear, customer-facing recommendations.
  • Excellent communication skills across technical and executive audiences, with the ability to operate independently in a remote, distributed environment across time zones.
  • Experience in a managed services, professional services, or TAM/CSM capacity with ongoing account ownership responsibility; scripting and automation skills (Python, JavaScript) and certifications in Zoom, CCNA Collaboration, or cloud contact center platforms are a plus.

job.title: Lead Technical SEO Manager
job.description:
What You Can Expect

This is a hands-on technical leadership role at the center of how Zoom gets found, understood, and surfaced across both traditional search engines and emerging AI-powered discovery platforms. You will own the technical SEO foundation across a complex, multi-platform web ecosystem spanning Optimizely CMS, WordPress, custom web applications, and modern frontend frameworks, translating search strategy into scalable production solutions. Working closely with SEO and Website Engineering leadership, you will drive high-impact implementations, build reusable SEO capabilities and automation, and establish the engineering standards that keep Zoom's digital presence ahead of the curve. Your work connects directly to organic visibility, pipeline, and revenue, and your fingerprints will be on the architecture decisions that shape how Zoom shows up across Google, ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, and the next generation of agentic web experiences.


About the Team


You will be part of Zoom's Website Engineering team within the Online Business organization, a cross-functional group of web engineers, CMS specialists, SEO and AEO experts, and performance engineers who build and scale the technical foundation powering Zoom's global web presence. The team collaborates closely with Marketing, Product, Design, Content, and Localization to deliver fast, accessible, and AI-ready digital experiences. Technical excellence, a bias toward automation, and engineering-by-design are at the core of how we operate.


Responsibilities


  • Lead the technical SEO roadmap and execution across Zoom's global web ecosystem, owning high-priority initiatives driven by SEO analysis, audits, crawl data, search performance data, server logs, technical root-cause analysis, and business priorities.
  • Translate SEO and AEO requirements into technical designs, development specifications, production implementations, and ongoing maintenance across Optimizely CMS, WordPress, custom web applications, APIs, and modern frontend frameworks, ensuring requirements are incorporated throughout the software development lifecycle.
  • Own technical solutions for crawlability, indexability, XML sitemaps, robots.txt, canonicalization, redirects, URL architecture, metadata, structured data, internal linking, hreflang, JavaScript rendering, client-side rendering, server-side rendering, static generation, incremental rendering, and search-friendly application architecture.
  • Build and scale reusable SEO capabilities including centralized metadata services, automated sitemap generation, structured-data components, redirect services, internal-linking systems, and standardized SEO configurations that platforms can inherit without repeated manual intervention.
  • Drive Core Web Vitals and web performance improvements, including LCP, INP, CLS, JavaScript execution, rendering performance, image optimization, font loading, third-party scripts, caching, CDN configuration, API performance, and server response times.
  • Develop automated testing, monitoring, dashboards, CI/CD quality gates, proactive alerting, and validation scripts that detect technical SEO issues and prevent regressions from reaching production across broken links, metadata, canonicalization, structured data, redirects, sitemaps, indexability, robots directives, duplicate URLs, internal linking, accessibility, performance, and rendering.
  • Establish the technical foundation for AEO and AI search by implementing structured data, semantic HTML, machine-readable metadata, entity and product schemas, and machine-readable endpoints; evaluate emerging AI-search and agentic-web standards and translate them into practical engineering requirements.
  • Define and maintain technical SEO standards and governance across Optimizely, WordPress, and custom applications, serving as the technical authority for SEO implementation within Web Engineering through reference architectures, launch-readiness criteria, design reviews, and code reviews.
  • Partner with SEO, Content, Product Marketing, Web Engineering, Product, and senior stakeholders to translate search strategy and business priorities into scalable technical solutions, improve Zoom's discoverability and representation across traditional search engines and AI-powered discovery platforms, and connect technical SEO initiatives to measurable organic visibility, acquisition, pipeline, and revenue outcomes.


What We're Looking For


  • 8+ years of experience in technical SEO, web engineering, or a related discipline, with a demonstrated track record leading technical SEO initiatives across large-scale websites and web applications in a B2B SaaS or enterprise technology environment; ability to connect technical SEO work directly to measurable organic visibility, acquisition, pipeline, and revenue outcomes.
  • Deep expertise in technical SEO fundamentals: crawlability, indexation, rendering, canonicalization, redirects, URL architecture, XML sitemaps, robots directives, structured data, internal linking, hreflang, and JavaScript-based web applications; hands-on proficiency with JavaScript, PHP, HTML, and CSS to diagnose and implement technical SEO fixes directly in the codebase and CMS, not only through engineering handoffs.
  • Proven experience improving web performance and Core Web Vitals, including diagnosing issues related to JavaScript execution, rendering, caching, CDN configuration, images, third-party scripts, APIs, and server performance.
  • Experience building scalable SEO capabilities, automation, monitoring, and CI/CD quality gates across enterprise CMS platforms such as Optimizely and WordPress; comfortable going directly into the CMS or codebase to implement configurations, standardize templates, and deploy SEO capabilities across multiple sites and applications without requiring a dedicated engineering sprint for every change.
  • Strong understanding of structured data, Schema.org, JSON-LD, semantic HTML, and the technical foundations required for AEO and AI-powered search, with familiarity with emerging AI search platforms including ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, and Google AI Overviews.
  • Strong analytical skills using tools such as Google Search Console, Screaming Frog, Semrush, Ahrefs, Sitebulb, analytics platforms, and application observability tools; experienced in analyzing server logs and crawl logs to identify crawl blocks, indexation gaps, rendering failures, and visibility issues across Google, AI search platforms, and LLM crawlers, and translating those findings into prioritized, actionable fixes.
  • Strong leadership, communication, and cross-functional collaboration skills, with the ability to influence engineering architecture, establish technical standards, and partner effectively with SEO, Web Engineering, Product, Marketing, Content, and senior stakeholders.

Salary Range or On Target Earnings:

Minimum:

$124,000.00

Maximum:

$271,200.00

job.description:
What You Can Expect

As a Digital Experience Specialist on Zoom's Content and Customer Advocacy team, you will play a hands-on role in shaping how millions of visitors discover, explore, and convert on zoom.com, partnering closely with the Digital Experience Lead across marketing, product marketing, design, SEO, and web engineering. Day to day, you will turn performance data into better customer journeys — auditing pages, drafting A/B test copy, optimizing for SEO, and contributing to the templates and governance standards that keep Zoom's 30+ product pages consistent and high-performing. This is an early-career role built for someone who is equally comfortable pulling an Amplitude dashboard and editing a hero headline, with a genuine curiosity for how a website functions as a product. You will be joining on the ground floor of Zoom's first dedicated Digital Experience function, with meaningful visibility and real impact from day one.


About the Team

The Content and Customer Advocacy team sits at the center of Zoom's marketing engine, owning content strategy, editorial programs, customer advocacy, and — most recently — the end-to-end digital experience on zoom.com. Our newly formed Digital Experience function is Zoom's first team dedicated to treating the website as a product, connecting content, design, experimentation, and data to build a cohesive and high-performing web presence for one of the world's most recognized brands. We work across the full funnel and stay relentlessly focused on measurable outcomes and business impact.


Responsibilities

  • Audit and optimize product pages, landing pages, and conversion paths across zoom.com, analyzing Amplitude performance data to identify friction points and recommend content, copy, and layout improvements with clear UX rationale.
  • Review web pages for scannability, narrative clarity, and CTA effectiveness, documenting structured observations and prioritized improvement recommendations for the Digital Experience Lead and cross-functional partners.
  • Draft, edit, and QA web copy across the full page hierarchy — hero headlines, CTA buttons, meta descriptions, and FAQ modules — ensuring alignment with Zoom's editorial style guide and brand voice.
  • Build and maintain performance dashboards in Amplitude to track page-level conversion metrics and experiment outcomes, and surface insights in weekly pod reviews.
  • Support the design, launch, and analysis of A/B and multivariate experiments, documenting hypotheses, results, and scaled learnings to guide ongoing optimization.
  • Execute on-page SEO priorities including keyword mapping, meta-tag optimization, internal linking, and content architecture improvements in partnership with the SEO team.
  • Contribute to scalable page templates, reusable content modules, and governance checklists that promote consistency across Zoom's 30+ product pages, and support the Digital Experience Lead in coordinating competing priorities across product teams and campaign pods.
  • Map and analyze visitor journeys for self-serve SMB and enterprise audiences across zoom.com, surfacing disconnects in content hierarchy, navigation, and conversion pathways and recommending improvements.

What We're Looking For

  • 2+ years of experience in digital marketing, web content strategy, conversion rate optimization, or a related field; internship and co-op experience counts.
  • Hands-on familiarity with web analytics platforms such as Amplitude, Google Analytics, or Adobe Analytics, with the ability to translate data into actionable content and UX recommendations.
  • Strong writing and editing skills with a clear eye for conversion-oriented web copy, and the ability to distinguish between a feature list and a compelling value proposition.
  • Exposure to A/B testing and experimentation methodologies using tools such as Optimizely or LaunchDarkly, or a strong and demonstrated interest in building that expertise.
  • Working knowledge of SEO fundamentals including on-page optimization, keyword research, structured data, and content architecture best practices; experience with tools such as Semrush, Ahrefs, or Screaming Frog is a plus.
  • Self-starter mindset with a foundational understanding of UX and web design principles, with the ability to analyze a page, articulate what is and is not working across layout, narrative, and CTAs, and communicate structured improvement ideas to senior teammates.
  • Comfort working cross-functionally with designers, engineers, product marketers, and campaign managers, and an eagerness to learn how a website operates as a product.

Minimum:

$65,400.00

Maximum:

$158,700.00

job.title: Senior Business Operations Analyst
job.description:
What You Can Expect

This role sits at the intersection of business operations, governance, and technology within Zoom's GTM Business Excellence team. You will help shape how Zoom goes to market by translating complex business decisions into durable, scalable processes, commercial policies, and operational playbooks. Working cross-functionally with Direct Sales, Channel, Finance, Legal, Deal Desk, and Enterprise Systems, you will own meaningful workstreams with real downstream impact on how Zoom sells and scales. If you are energized by operating at the center of fast-moving go-to-market motions and turning complexity into clarity, this is a place where your work compounds across the organization.


About the Team

GTM Business Excellence designs the cross-functional processes and commercial policies that keep Zoom's go-to-market engine moving at speed without collision. The team partners with Direct Sales, Channel, Deal Desk, Finance, Legal, Sales Compensation, and Enterprise Systems to ensure new business motions are operationally sound, well-governed, and built to scale. It is a team for people who thrive at the center of complexity and want to build things that last.


Responsibilities

  • Evaluate the operational and commercial feasibility of new go-to-market initiatives across Direct and Channel, identifying downstream impacts across bookings, compensation, partner incentives, and billing before launch
  • Own assigned workstreams within cross-functional initiatives, tracking milestones, dependencies, and risks while keeping stakeholders aligned on progress
  • Translate business requirements into scalable process and system specifications, partnering with Enterprise Systems to deliver fully implemented solutions including UAT coordination and run-the-business handoff
  • Design and maintain repositories of key business decisions and commercial policies, ensuring documentation remains current, searchable, and consistently applied across routes to market
  • Create detailed process maps and standard operating procedures that distinguish standard workflows from exception paths, and review policies for consistency and gaps across routes to market
  • Analyze support ticket and exception trends to identify root causes and recommend process or policy improvements that reduce manual effort and downstream disruption
  • Serve as a subject-matter expert in Zoom's opportunity lifecycle and quoting processes, assess enhancement requests, and help prioritize improvements to opportunity management and quoting systems
  • Build training collateral and facilitate workshops to drive adoption of new processes and best practices across seller and partner audiences
  • Develop reports tracking process adherence, opportunity and quote data quality, and cycle time to support continuous improvement
  • Identify and pilot opportunities to apply automation and AI to reduce manual effort and measure impact

What We're Looking For

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Operations, Information Systems, or a related field, plus 5+ years in Sales Operations, Business Operations, Deal Desk, or a similar role in a SaaS or high-growth environment
  • Hands-on experience with enterprise GTM systems such as Salesforce, CPQ, or ERP, with the ability to translate business requirements into system specifications
  • Deep understanding of commercial policies, business rules, and cross-functional GTM processes including opportunity lifecycle, quoting, and lead-to-cash or quote-to-cash operations
  • Strong analytical, root-cause problem-solving, process mapping, and documentation skills
  • Proven project management and stakeholder coordination capabilities across diverse, cross-functional teams
  • Familiarity with partner ecosystems, channel sales models, partner incentive programs, and sales compensation structures (preferred)
  • Working knowledge of reporting and analytics tools such as Tableau or SQL, and experience applying AI tools to improve workflows and productivity (preferred)

job.title: Marketing Data Operations Analyst
job.description:
What You Can Expect

As our Marketing Data Operations Analyst, you will serve as both a technical expert and an advisory partner to EMEA marketing stakeholders, translating complex data into clear, actionable insights that drive smarter campaign and strategic decisions. You will own the segmentation, database management, and data quality frameworks that power Zoom's marketing database, working closely with the wider Marketing Operations team, IT, and Data teams. This role sits within the Digital Transformation Office, giving you visibility across how data strategy connects to enterprise marketing outcomes at scale. This role requires working hours aligned to EMEA markets, with a shift of 12:30 PM to 8:30 PM IST.


About the Team

The Marketing Data Operations team is part of the wider Marketing Operations team within Zoom's Digital Transformation Office and is responsible for the infrastructure, processes, and operational frameworks that power our marketing database. We enable data accessibility, quality, and operational execution for Enterprise Marketing, ensuring that marketing teams have reliable, actionable data to inform campaigns and strategic decisions. We are a collaborative team working across Marketing Operations, IT, and Data functions to keep Zoom's marketing database accurate, current, and strategically aligned.


Responsibilities

  • Analyze audience and database performance metrics, surfacing key trends, patterns, and actionable insights that inform EMEA marketing strategy and decision-making.
  • Develop and deliver recurring insight outputs including audience health readouts, engagement trend analyses, and segmentation performance summaries for marketing stakeholders.
  • Identify gaps, inefficiencies, and systemic issues in current processes, segmentation logic, and data quality, leading continuous improvement initiatives without waiting for escalation.
  • Create, manage, and evolve audience segments and segmentation models aligned to EMEA regional objectives, translating marketing requirements into effective audience builds grounded in business context.
  • Own compliance with privacy regulations including GDPR and internal opt-in requirements for new and existing data within the marketing database.
  • Collaborate with Data Operations, Marketing Operations, and cross-functional IT and Data teams to ensure the marketing database remains accurate, current, and aligned with organizational needs.
  • Build and maintain proactive relationships with EMEA marketing stakeholders, delivering enablement sessions that improve their understanding and utilization of Zoom's marketing database.
  • Communicate complex data concepts clearly and concisely to non-technical stakeholders, providing data-driven context that explains what the data means and what actions it suggests.


What We're Looking For

  • Bachelor's degree in a technology, data, or business-related field, or equivalent experience, with 8 or more years of experience working with large-scale B2B or B2C marketing databases.
  • Strong knowledge of marketing data ecosystems including CRM systems (Salesforce), marketing automation platforms (Pardot/Marketing Cloud Account Engagement), CDP platforms (Data Cloud), data warehouses (Snowflake), and BI tools (Tableau).
  • Strong proficiency in SQL, with the ability to write and optimize complex queries for segmentation, analysis, and performance reporting.
  • Demonstrated ability to translate data into business-facing insights, articulating not just what the data shows but what it means for marketing stakeholders and what actions it might inform.
  • Proven ability to own and deliver projects independently from scoping to completion, managing timelines and stakeholder expectations without constant oversight.
  • A proactive, problem-solving mindset that identifies issues before they are reported, brings solutions alongside diagnosis, and drives improvement without waiting for direction.
  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to explain complex data concepts to non-technical audiences clearly and concisely, both in writing and verbally, combined with strong attention to detail and a quality-first approach.

job.title: Premier Support Manager
job.description:
What You Can Expect


Lead a team of Technical Account Managers at the center of Zoom's most strategic enterprise relationships, directly shaping customer outcomes and the long-term health of the Premier Support portfolio. Day to day, you will develop your team, define performance goals, and serve as an executive escalation point for complex customer situations, working closely with Customer Success, Service Engineering, and Sales. This is a role for someone who leads with data, builds accountability with genuine care, and is committed to developing people alongside delivering results. You will report to senior leadership within the Global Premier Support organization. This is a hybrid position that requires on-site presence 2 days per week at our San Jose, CA office. Remote arrangements are not available for this role.


About the Team


The Premier Support team delivers high-touch technical account management for Zoom's most strategic enterprise customers, helping them realize the full value of Zoom Workplace. Working at the intersection of technical expertise and relationship management, the team partners closely with Sales, Customer Success, and Engineering to resolve complex challenges and drive proactive outcomes. As a core part of Zoom's customer experience strategy, the team plays a meaningful role in retention, expansion, and satisfaction across the Premier portfolio.


Responsibilities


  • Lead, coach, and develop a team of Technical Account Managers, building the skills and competencies needed to deliver outstanding Premier Support experiences.
  • Recruit, onboard, and grow talent within the TAM organization, ensuring all business processes and quality standards are upheld.
  • Define and drive team KPIs, quarterly goals, and strategic initiatives aligned to the broader Premier Services program.
  • Analyze team performance data and process metrics to proactively identify risk factors, growth opportunities, and areas for continuous improvement.
  • Own executive-level escalation for complex customer situations, partnering with Customer Success Managers, Escalations, and Service Engineering to drive timely resolution.
  • Partner with Account Executives and Customer Success Managers to strengthen customer relationships and support retention and growth across the Premier portfolio.
  • Identify underperformance within the team and manage structured improvement plans with appropriate senior support.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional leaders to deliver data-driven decisions that strengthen team processes and the Premier Services program.

What We're Looking For


  • 5+ years of experience managing technical teams in a customer-facing organization, with a track record of developing high-performing talent.
  • 5+ years of experience in the SaaS industry and/or Unified Communications space, with deep familiarity with enterprise collaboration environments.
  • Demonstrated ability to communicate with and influence executive-level stakeholders, including delivering compelling presentations and driving strategic alignment.
  • Proven track record of executing strategy at operational and organizational scale, using data and performance metrics to inform decisions.
  • Experience leveraging AI tools and solutions to deliver measurable improvements in team efficiency and service delivery.
  • Familiarity with Unified Communications technologies such as Zoom Workplace, Cisco, Microsoft, or equivalent platforms; knowledge of IP telephony, SIP, or API/SDK integration is a plus.
  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.

job.title: Physical Security Technology and Operations Specialist
job.description:
What You Can Expect

This role sits at the intersection of physical security technology and operational resilience, giving you the opportunity to shape and advance Zoom's global security infrastructure across offices and data centers worldwide. The work spans cloud-native video management, enterprise access control, AI-assisted monitoring, and automation platforms, partnering with cross-functional teams to keep Zoom's people, facilities, and operations safe and secure. Expect real breadth: from leading technology design and deployment to supporting 24/7 business continuity, this position rewards both technical depth and collaborative problem-solving. This is a hybrid position that requires on-site presence 4 days per week at our London, England office. Remote arrangements are not available for this role.


About the Team

The Global Physical Security and Safety team protects Zoom's people, assets, and operations across a worldwide portfolio of offices and data centers. Partnering closely with Workplace, Business Resilience, EHS, IT, and external vendors, the team delivers integrated security solutions built to scale with Zoom's growth. This London-based role serves as a key regional presence within a globally connected team, reporting to the Senior Manager of Global Physical Security and Safety.


Responsibilities

  • Partner with the physical security team, cross-functional counterparts (Workplace, Business Resilience, EHS, IT), and external partners on all physical security technology and design matters impacting people, facilities, and processes.
  • Advise on and guide security planning for new office design, expansions, conversions, and restructuring, serving as the liaison between Workplace, Physical Security, Business Resilience, and EHS to promote change management and ensure compliance with standards.
  • Design and propose integrated physical security solutions for deterrence, delay, detection, and response to threats, leading design reviews with key stakeholders to ensure protection-in-depth across all Zoom locations.
  • Prepare RFPs with technical requirements and cost estimates, lead bid reviews with stakeholders, support procurement and contracting, and provide quality assurance on bills of materials for security integrators.
  • Lead installation and acceptance testing phases for physical security system upgrades and new deployments, coordinating closely with vendors and key stakeholders throughout.
  • Own the full lifecycle of physical security system assets, including SOP development, periodic testing and auditing, maintenance, troubleshooting of system and network issues, and annual training delivery.
  • Manage the physical security systems budget across Zoom locations, and contribute to ongoing research, policy review, and technology recommendations that strengthen Zoom's security posture.
  • Provide operational support to the physical security team, maintaining 24/7 business resilience across Zoom's worldwide office and data center portfolio, with flexibility to support global sites across time zones.

What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years of experience in physical security for a private sector multinational company, including management of security technology projects, scope, budget, and third-party contracts.
  • Demonstrated expertise in physical security technology controls, including Automated Access Control Systems (AACS), CCTV, intrusion detection, and alarm systems, with experience leading design and implementation projects.
  • Familiarity with vulnerability and threat assessments, incident management, site assessments, and general security operations in enterprise or critical infrastructure environments.
  • Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, with a track record of collaborating across cross-functional teams including IT, Workplace, Facilities, and external vendors.
  • Proficiency in Google Suite, Microsoft Office, Asana, and Adobe, with the ability to produce clear technical documentation including SOPs, RFPs, and BOMs.
  • Certified Protection Professional (CPP) and/or Physical Security Professional (PSP), or equivalent certification.
  • Bachelor's degree in a related field, or equivalent experience, with the ability to travel globally to Zoom office and data center locations.

job.title: Senior Revenue Operations Analyst
job.description:
What You Can Expect

As a Senior Revenue Operations Analyst, you'll sit at the center of Zoom's Go-To-Market and Revenue Operations function, where your work shapes how we scale a compliant, data-driven revenue engine globally. You'll partner closely with Sales, Finance, Legal, and IT to design processes that are both rigorous and adaptable, bringing clarity to complex cross-functional challenges. This role offers real ownership across the full Demand-to-Retention lifecycle, from pipeline strategy to CPQ and renewals, giving you the breadth to grow as a systems and process leader. You'll operate as a trusted voice in strategic conversations, translating business needs into scalable solutions that directly impact how Zoom goes to market.


About the Team

Our Go-To-Market and Revenue Operations team sits at the intersection of strategy and execution, working cross-functionally with Sales, Finance, Legal, Customer Operations, and IT to build a scalable and compliant revenue engine. We are focused on process excellence and systems strategy, enabling smarter Go-To-Market growth and more efficient revenue management across the business.


Responsibilities

  • Own and optimize end-to-end Demand-to-Retention (D2R) processes across lead generation, opportunity conversion, pipeline management, forecasting, CPQ/quote-to-cash, renewals, and expansion
  • Analyze pipeline health, conversion metrics, and forecast accuracy to surface insights that drive revenue performance
  • Design and improve workflows, controls, and business rules to support scalable Go-To-Market operations
  • Partner with Go-To-Market and Finance teams on pricing, deal structure, and new sales motions
  • Identify operational gaps and lead process and system improvements across the revenue lifecycle
  • Translate business requirements into Salesforce/CPQ configurations and support end-to-end delivery
  • Operationalize policy through scalable processes and governance controls that support compliance
  • Drive enablement and adoption of new processes, tools, and operational standards across stakeholder teams

What We're Looking For

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, or a related field, or equivalent experience; advanced degree is a plus
  • 6+ years of experience in Go-To-Market Operations, Revenue Operations, or Business Process roles
  • Proven hands-on experience with Salesforce CRM (SFDC) and CPQ tools, including platforms such as Leadspace, LeanData, Clari, ZoomInfo, Zuora, Lusha, or comparable solutions
  • Deep understanding of Demand-to-Retention (D2R) processes within a SaaS environment
  • Demonstrated ability to drive cross-functional initiatives, system enhancements, and stakeholder alignment
  • Strong analytical, communication, and stakeholder management skills
  • Understanding and knowledge of how to use LLM within your everyday work
  • Experience in scaling or SOX-compliant environments is a plus

job.title: Account Executive - Education
job.description:
What you can expect

Zoom is seeking an Account Executive to sell our Zoom Workplace platform to K-12 Education accounts within Oregon, Washington, Alaska, Utah, Wyoming, Idaho and Montana. In this role, you will engage with new leads and existing customers, helping them modernize communication and collaboration with Zoom solutions.


About the Team

job.title: Renewal Operations Manager
job.description:
What You Can Expect

This role is the operational backbone of Zoom’s Renewals function, responsible for transforming how the business forecasts, interprets, and acts on renewal and churn performance across a global, multi-geo post-sales organization. You will partner directly with Data Science, Analytics, Finance, Customer Success, and Renewals leadership to refine and scale an existing forecasting framework, surface leading indicators early, and build executive-ready insights that drive clear decisions and accountable outcomes.
This is a high-velocity environment where the expectation is to make an impact immediately: data ownership sits with partner teams, which means your ability to collaborate, influence without authority, and build trusted relationships is as important as your analytical depth. This is a hybrid position that requires on-site presence 2 days per week at our San Jose, CA office.


About the Team


The Retention Operations team is part of Zoom’s broader post-sales organization, which spans deployment, Customer Success, and Renewals across four global theaters, each led by geo-focused Renewals leaders. The team’s mission is to bring structure, rigor, and accountability to a Renewals function that is actively maturing: building the standardized forecasting cadence, governance, and operational infrastructure that Zoom’s scale now demands. By aligning data, tooling, and process across cross-functional partners, Retention Operations enables Renewals leadership to make faster, more confident decisions that protect and grow Zoom’s recurring revenue base.


Responsibilities

  • Own end-to-end renewals and churn forecasting, including methodology refinement, model design, reporting, and operational cadence, serving as the primary point of contact for renewals forecasting in partnership with FP&A and Renewals leadership.
  • Establish quarterly and half-year churn and renewals forecasts by synthesizing predictive models, historical performance, business signals, and field inputs into a bottoms-up, account- and product-level outlook.
  • Drive measurable improvement in forecasting accuracy as the primary lagging metric, identifying and closing gaps between early-quarter assumptions and in-quarter actuals.
  • Continuously improve forecasting models in collaboration with Analytics and Data Science, incorporating leading indicators to increase accuracy, confidence, and visibility.
  • Serve as a trusted advisor to Renewals leadership, developing an independent, data-backed view of business performance and constructively challenging forecast assumptions when data indicates a different outcome.
  • Proactively identify and communicate material in-quarter changes based on shifts in model predictions, leading indicators, and business performance, independent of Renewal Manager (RM)-reported line of sight.
  • Drive cross-functional alignment across Renewals, Customer Success, Sales, and Finance on forecast assumptions, account ownership, renewal timing, risks, and execution.
  • Establish governance around renewal processes and programs, covering suspensions, account movement, deal hygiene, and end-to-end program performance tracking and optimization.
  • Build executive-ready reporting and insights that clearly articulate forecast movement, churn and contraction risk, key drivers, forecast gaps, and required actions.
  • Partner with Analytics and Data Science to evolve predictive capabilities, including churn-risk and renewal opportunity scoring, to improve prioritization and decision-making.
  • Collaborate with Renewals leadership and Finance on long-range planning, capacity modeling, and target setting for the Renewals organization.
  • Identify and lead process, tooling, and automation improvements that reduce manual effort, improve RM productivity, and increase operational scalability.
  • Partner with Compensation and Finance on renewals compensation operations, including attainment calculations, quota setting, and payout validation.

What We’re Looking For

  • 8+ years in RevOps, SalesOps, RenewalOps, or RetentionOps with demonstrated ownership of forecasting and business performance in a recurring-revenue environment.
  • Proven ownership of renewals or retention forecasting methodology, with fluency in GRR, NRR, and churn metrics and experience translating those signals into bottoms-up forecasts and executive-ready insights.
  • Strong business judgment with the ability to develop an independent, data-backed point of view, constructively challenge assumptions, and influence senior leaders across Renewals, Finance, and Customer Success.
  • Strong analytical skills with experience building forecasts, dashboards, and executive reporting, translating complex data into clear business recommendations.
  • Demonstrated ability to partner effectively across cross-functional teams including Finance, Renewals, Customer Success, Analytics, and Data Science, including in environments with challenging stakeholder groups and limited prior operational support.
  • Proficiency with Salesforce and BI tools such as Tableau or Looker; experience with Clari or equivalent revenue forecasting platforms strongly preferred.
  • Experience in enterprise SaaS or subscription-based tech with a track record of driving measurable improvements in forecasting accuracy, retention, or RM productivity, and the proven ability to thrive in fast-paced, ambiguous environments with minimal process infrastructure.

job.title: Senior Business Operations Analyst
job.description:
What You Can Expect

As a Senior Business Operations Analyst on the GTM Business Excellence team, you will shape how Zoom's go-to-market motions operate at scale, translating complex commercial and operational challenges into durable, standing policy that drives consistency across Direct and Channel sales. Day to day, you will lead multi-workstream initiatives from concept through handoff, partner closely with Enterprise Systems to deliver scalable solutions, and use data to surface systemic root causes rather than chasing recurring workarounds. This role requires someone with deep experience leading cross-functional initiatives in a SaaS environment and the executive communication skills to influence senior stakeholders without formal authority. Candidates without a background in Sales Operations, Deal Desk, or a closely related GTM function are unlikely to succeed in this role.


About the Team

GTM Business Excellence is the operational backbone of Zoom's go-to-market organization, designing the cross-functional processes and governance structures that allow Direct Sales, Channel, Deal Desk, Finance, Legal, and Sales Compensation teams to move quickly without collision. The team owns the frameworks, decision rights, and operating standards that convert key business decisions into scalable, consistently applied policy across every route to market.


Responsibilities

  • Lead complex, multi-workstream go-to-market Initiatives end-to-end across Direct and Channel sales, establishing clear governance, ownership, and timelines while synthesizing process, system, policy, and downstream impacts (bookings credit, sales compensation, partner incentives, billing) into actionable recommendations for senior leadership.
  • Drive operational and commercial feasibility assessments for new business initiatives, anticipating cross-program dependencies and risks and proactively coordinating adjustments with cross-functional partners.
  • Serve as the primary liaison between GTM Business Excellence and Enterprise Systems, owning business requirements quality and full accountability through UAT, delivery, and handoff to run-the-business teams.
  • Design and continuously improve the governance framework that converts key business decisions into standing policy, including decision rights (RACI), review cadences, documentation standards, and change management.
  • Lead the COE operating rhythm for Opportunity Lifecycle Management and Quoting, building dashboards and metrics that measure process health, adoption, data quality, and cycle time to inform executive decision-making.
  • Use ticket, exception, and performance data to identify systemic root causes and drive their elimination, partnering with Sales, Channel, and Deal Desk leadership to align COE priorities with GTM strategy.
  • Mentor team members on structured problem-solving and process design, and lead the integration of AI and automation into team workflows, establishing standards and measuring impact.

What We're Looking For

  • 8+ years in Sales Operations, Business Operations, Deal Desk, or related strategic planning roles in a SaaS or high-growth environment, with a demonstrated track record of leading complex, cross-functional initiatives from concept through launch and handoff.
  • Proven experience working with Enterprise Systems (Salesforce, CPQ, ERP) and translating business needs into scalable system requirements, with ownership of requirements quality through UAT and solution delivery.
  • Experience designing governance frameworks, decision rights (RACI), or Center of Excellence operating models, including standards for process and policy documentation, version control, and change management.
  • Deep understanding of commercial policies, business rules, and process optimization methodologies, with the ability to use data to identify systemic root causes and drive durable fixes.
  • Strong executive communication and influencing skills, with proven ability to present clear, structured recommendations to senior leaders across Sales, Finance, Legal, and Enterprise Systems.
  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Operations, Information Systems, or a related field.
  • Familiarity with partner ecosystems, channel sales models, lead-to-cash operations, and partner incentive programs; working knowledge of Tableau or SQL; Lean, Six Sigma, or PMP certification is a plus.

job.title: Full Stack Developer
job.description:
What You Can Expect

As a Full Stack Developer at Zoom, you will take end-to-end ownership of features and services that reach users worldwide, from design through deployment, monitoring, and production support. This role spans backend engineering, frontend development, and applied AI, offering you the chance to build meaningful, scalable solutions across the full technology stack. You will work with autonomy and collaborate closely with cross-functional partners who value craft, curiosity, and continuous improvement. This is a hybrid position that requires on-site presence 2–3 days per week at our San Jose, CA office. Remote arrangements are not available for this role.


About the Team

You will join a team of engineers building systems that support Zoom's platform at scale, working across backend services, intelligent APIs, and AI-enabled workflows. The team values end-to-end ownership, technical rigor, and a collaborative approach to solving complex problems. You will partner closely with product, design, and infrastructure partners to ship features that make a real difference to how people connect and collaborate.


Responsibilities

  • Build scalable full stack applications using Java, Spring Boot, modern frontend frameworks (React, Angular, TypeScript), REST and GraphQL APIs, and relational and NoSQL databases.
  • Design and maintain robust backend services and APIs with a focus on performance, security, and long-term reliability.
  • Build and integrate AI and LLM-based solutions including AI agents, RAG pipelines, tool calling, and prompt-based workflows, with working knowledge of Model Context Protocol (MCP).
  • Own features from end to end, covering design, development, testing, deployment, monitoring, and production support.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve issues across the full stack, including frontend, backend, APIs, and database layers.
  • Apply AI-assisted development tools such as Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or similar to accelerate delivery and improve code quality.

What We're Looking For

  • 5–8 years of software development experience with proven full stack expertise.
  • Hands-on proficiency with Java, Spring Boot, REST APIs, and microservices architecture.
  • Experience building frontend applications with React, Angular, JavaScript/TypeScript, or equivalent frameworks.
  • Strong knowledge of SQL databases, data modeling, and query optimization, plus familiarity with NoSQL databases.
  • Working knowledge of Generative AI, LLMs, AI agents, RAG, prompt engineering, and Model Context Protocol (MCP).
  • Practical experience with AWS or comparable cloud platforms, Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD pipelines, Git, OAuth2, RBAC, and application security fundamentals.
  • Solid grasp of system design, distributed systems, scalability principles, and engineering best practices, with the ability to drive features independently and collaborate effectively with cross-functional stakeholders.

job.title: Renewals Manager - Federal
job.description:
What You Can Expect

As a Renewals Manager on the Federal team, you’ll take ownership of a strategic book of federal business, protecting and growing Zoom’s installed base through disciplined renewal management and meaningful customer engagement. Your work will shift between finalizing renewals, forecasting pipeline, and uncovering expansion opportunities that create lasting value for government customers. You’ll partner closely with Sales, Finance, and Customer Success to navigate complex deals and build the trust that keeps federal agencies coming back. This is a quota-carrying role that rewards strategic thinkers who bring genuine curiosity to customer challenges and care deeply about long-term outcomes.


About the Team

The Renewals team at Zoom sits at the intersection of customer success and revenue growth, focused on retention, expansion, and delivering measurable value across Zoom’s customer base. On the Federal side, the team partners closely with account teams to strengthen relationships with government agencies, navigate complex procurement cycles, and ensure Zoom’s platform continues to meet mission-critical needs.


Responsibilities

  • Manage and track a federal renewals book of business with a focus on growing MRR and NRR
  • Negotiate renewal terms, pricing, and contract extensions, with an emphasis on upsell, cross-sell, and multi-year agreements
  • Articulate Zoom’s platform value from a benefits and TCO perspective, adapting messaging to different stakeholder personas
  • Develop and execute renewal strategies to maximize customer retention and revenue, using market trend analysis and customer data to surface improvement opportunities
  • Build consultative relationships with federal customers through proactive renewal activities, including renewal reviews, discovery sessions, and executive outreach, while advocating for customer needs internally
  • Lead retention efforts for at-risk accounts by facilitating TCO and competitive discussions and fostering cross-functional accountability
  • Gather and incorporate customer feedback to continuously improve the renewal experience
  • Forecast weekly, quarterly, and quarter+1 renewal opportunities, churn, risks, and upsell potential using Clari, and maintain accurate customer records in Salesforce

What We’re Looking For

  • 3+ years of experience in a SaaS or cloud company, with a background in sales, customer success, or renewals
  • Have experience working within the Federal vertical
  • Proven experience managing complex renewal negotiations and multi-year contract structures
  • Strong collaboration, negotiation, and relationship-building skills with a track record of client satisfaction and cross-functional teamwork
  • Proficiency in renewal forecasting, pipeline development, and opportunity management
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with demonstrated ability to deliver strategic, audience-tailored presentations
  • Familiarity with CRM and revenue operations tools such as Salesforce and Clari
  • Reside in the Northeast region

job.title: Premier Support Manager
job.description:
What You Can Expect


As a Premier Support Manager, you will lead a team of Technical Account Managers delivering high-touch support for Zoom's most strategic enterprise accounts, with direct influence over customer outcomes and the ongoing strength of our Premier Support portfolio. Day to day, you will coach and develop your team, set performance goals, and act as an executive escalation resource for complex customer situations, working in close partnership with Customer Success, Service Engineering, and Sales. This role suits a leader who combines data-driven accountability with genuine investment in people, someone who finds meaning in growing talent alongside delivering results. You will report to senior leadership within Zoom's Global Premier Support organization, and the role may require occasional travel to Zoom offices and customer sites.


About the Team


The Premier Support team delivers high-touch technical account management for Zoom's most strategic enterprise customers, helping them realize the full value of Zoom Workplace. The team works at the intersection of technical expertise and relationship management, partnering with Sales, Customer Success, and Engineering to address complex challenges and drive proactive outcomes. As a key part of Zoom's customer experience strategy, the team plays a meaningful role in retention, expansion, and satisfaction across the Premier portfolio.


Responsibilities


  • Lead, coach, and develop a team of Technical Account Managers, building the skills and competencies needed to deliver outstanding Premier Support experiences.
  • Recruit, onboard, and grow talent within the TAM team, ensuring all business processes and quality standards are upheld.
  • Define and drive team KPIs, quarterly goals, and strategic initiatives aligned to the broader Premier Services program.
  • Analyze team performance data and process metrics to proactively identify risk factors, growth opportunities, and areas for continuous improvement.
  • Serve as an executive-level escalation point for complex customer situations, partnering with Customer Success Managers, Escalations, and Service Engineering to drive timely resolution.
  • Partner with Account Executives and Customer Success Managers to strengthen customer relationships and support retention and growth across the Premier Service portfolio.
  • Identify underperformance trends and lead structured improvement plans with appropriate senior support.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional leaders to deliver data-driven decisions that enhance team processes and strengthen the Premier Services program.

What We're Looking For


  • 5+ years of experience managing technical teams in a customer-facing organization, with a track record of developing high-performing talent.
  • 5+ years of experience in the SaaS industry and/or Unified Communications space, with deep familiarity with enterprise collaboration environments.
  • Demonstrated ability to communicate with and influence stakeholders at the executive level, including delivering compelling presentations and driving strategic alignment.
  • Proven track record of executing strategy at an operational and organizational scale, using data and performance metrics to inform decisions.
  • Experience leveraging AI tools and solutions to deliver measurable improvements in team efficiency and service delivery.
  • Familiarity with Unified Communications technologies such as Zoom Workplace, Cisco, Microsoft, or equivalent platforms; knowledge of IP telephony, SIP, or API/SDK integration is a plus.

job.title: Product Growth Marketing Manager
job.description:
What You Can Expect

Zoom's AI products are growing fast - and we need someone equally fast to help fuel that growth. We're hiring a Product Growth Marketing Manager who thinks like a founder, moves like a creator, and lives at the intersection of AI and user obsession. You'll be marketing AI-powered products like ZoomMate, My Notes, Webinars, AI Productivity Suite, or Zoom Virtual Agent (ZVA) - which means you need to deeply understand how AI works, how people adopt it, and how to make cutting-edge technology feel approachable. This is not a "make the deck pretty" gig. This is a build-it, ship-it, measure-it, do-it-again kind of role - and we want someone who wouldn't have it any other way.


About the Team

Zoom is building a new AI-native way to work—helping users move faster from conversation and ideation to polished, editable deliverables. As these products grow, this role will help more users understand its value and adopt it in their daily work. We're a product-led team looking for someone with sharp product judgment, hands-on content execution, and a genuine understanding of how people work and what earns their attention.


Responsibilities

  • Running growth experiments from zero to results - you own the idea, the launch, the data, and the next move. No red tape, no waiting around.
  • Showing up where our users already are - TikTok, Instagram, LinkedIn, YouTube, podcasts, niche communities. You know the landscape because you live in it.
  • Creating content that people actually stop scrolling for - short-form video, social posts, blogs, threads, whatever format wins. You'll figure it out, then do more of it.
  • Partnering with Product, Engineering, and Design to turn product features into stories real people care about.
  • Leveraging AI tools to move faster and smarter - you'll use generative AI, automation platforms, and AI-driven analytics to supercharge your workflow. If you're not already experimenting with AI in your day-to-day, this isn't the role for you.
  • Living in the data - funnel metrics, engagement rates, conversion signals. You'll know what's working, what's not, and you'll act on it fast.
  • Being the voice of the user in every room you walk into - bringing outside-in perspective to launches, campaigns, and strategy.

What We're Looking For

  • You have 1–5 years of experience in growth marketing, product marketing, community building, content creation, or a related entrepreneurial hustle - with real, measurable results across social channels.
  • Startup DNA runs in your blood. You've worked at a small company, launched a side project, built something from nothing, freelanced your way through a problem - whatever it was, you operated like "creating a startup."
  • You have hands-on experience with AI-generated content, workflows, and analytics.
  • You're social-media native and understand how audiences, content formats, and distribution differ across TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube, X, Reddit, and LinkedIn—with demonstrated depth on multiple platforms.
  • You bias toward action. You ship fast, learn faster, and aren't afraid to fail in public. You're comfortable operating in ambiguity with minimal hand-holding.
  • You communicate with clarity and impact. Written, verbal, visual - you can make complex ideas simple and compelling.



Location: We are open to remote candidates in the US, or hybrid at our San Jose or Seattle offices.
