job.title: Senior Sales Operations Manager, EMEA Central
job.description:
What You Can Expect


In this role, you will work as a trusted embedded partner to Sales Segment leaders, helping shape how Zoom's sales organization operates and grows. You will bring analytical depth and strategic thinking to some of the most complex challenges in our go-to-market motion, from quota and territory planning to pipeline health and executive reporting. This is a role for someone who is equally comfortable designing a KPI framework and presenting findings to a leadership audience.


This role is ideally based in Germany and fluent in German is required


About the Team

Our Sales Operations team partners closely with Sales leadership, Finance, Marketing, and GTM Insights to keep Zoom's go-to-market engine running efficiently and intelligently. We are a cross-functional team that values precision, clear thinking, and a bias toward action. Our work directly influences how Zoom grows and how effectively our sales teams can do their best work.


Responsibilities

  • Evaluate complex business problems, design and implement actionable recommendations, and track success metrics across your assigned sales segment
  • Partner with the Go-to-Market Insights team to quantify market opportunity and translate findings into recommendations on sales resource and quota planning
  • Define, manage, and deliver insights on key performance indicators (KPIs) across direct, indirect, SMB, and Enterprise selling segments
  • Develop expertise in Sales Segmentation definitions, Booking Policy, and Global Rules of Engagement, including supporting resolution of policy questions and assessing the impact of privacy and security considerations on the business
  • Co-lead executive analyses, strategies, and deliverables including QBRs and executive presentations; synthesize complex data into clear, concise recommendations for senior audiences
  • Leverage Zoom's sales technology stack to deliver regular reporting to sales leadership and executive stakeholders on activities, product performance, and pipeline health
  • Lead cross-functional initiatives to streamline processes, automate key workflows, and drive improvements in sales productivity and velocity
  • Deliver a connected planning environment across quota management, territory management, pipeline management, forecasting, and GTM planning in collaboration with Finance, Marketing, HR, and Sales Support teams
  • Partner with Sales Enablement and internal systems teams on scoping, requirements definition, and implementation of tools and processes that support rep effectiveness and reduce ramp time

What We're Looking For

  • 6+ years of experience in Sales Operations, Sales Strategy, or Business Operations in a global SaaS or high-growth B2B environment, with familiarity across multi-product and technical sales models
  • Advanced proficiency in Salesforce.com, Google Workspace, and Excel; comfortable adopting and optimizing other sales technology platforms and CRM tools
  • Demonstrated experience partnering with senior and C-level stakeholders and translating complex data into clear strategic recommendations for executive audiences
  • Strong analytical and reporting capabilities with a proven track record managing KPI frameworks, forecasting processes, and quota and territory planning at scale
  • Experience leading cross-functional programs and managing multiple initiatives with competing priorities in a fast-paced environment
  • Outcomes-oriented with a consistent record of improving sales productivity, operational efficiency, and revenue program performance
  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Economics, Communications, or a related field; MBA or advanced degree preferred
  • Fluent in German

job.title: Sales Development Manager, Workvivo
job.description:
What you can expect

Workvivo is the employee communications platform trusted by some of the world's most recognisable brands, now scaling globally as part of Zoom. We connect millions of employees to their companies' culture, leadership and purpose and our Sales Development org is a critical engine of that growth.

We're hiring a Sales Development Manager to lead our EMEA & APJ Sales Development team. You'll manage a team of SDRs across the region, reporting directly to the Head of Sales Development. You'll be responsible for turning strategy into execution — driving pipeline performance, developing your team, building a strong coaching culture and ensuring our EMEA & APJ SDR motion operates with pace, consistency and discipline.

We're looking for a hands-on leader who coaches in the trenches, knows how to develop SDR talent and can create the environment where people consistently perform at their best.


About the team

Workvivo operates at the intersection of employee communications and employee insights, serving mid-market and enterprise companies globally. Our buyers are CHROs, CTOs, CIOs and Internal Comms Directors — a senior, multi-stakeholder profile that rewards insight-led, persona-aware outreach over high-volume spray approaches.

This is a genuinely exciting moment to join. Workvivo recently launched Seer, our employee insights solution, bringing listening, analytics and action into a single platform alongside our communications product. And with Workvivo HQ — our AI-native employee experience platform — now in market, we have a compelling, expanded story to take to enterprise buyers. Two strong products, a rapidly expanding global footprint, and the backing of Zoom's worldwide network: the opportunity to build pipeline at scale and make a material impact on Workvivo's next chapter of growth has never been greater.

The EMEA & APJ SDR team operates a balanced motion: structured outbound sequencing into target accounts alongside managed inbound response. You'll be responsible for ensuring the team executes both motions effectively, understands when to prioritise each and consistently delivers high-quality pipeline to the sales organisation.


Responsibilities

  • Own EMEA & APJ Sales Development Representative performance - deliver against regional meeting, SQO and pipeline targets, with clear focus on the inputs and behaviors that drive results
  • Translate global strategy into EMEA & APJ execution - ensure global SDR priorities, playbooks and programmes are adopted effectively across the region
  • Build a daily coaching culture - coach reps through call reviews, roleplay, 1:1s and live feedback to continuously improve performance
  • Develop and retain talent - identify high performers, create development plans and address performance gaps with clear expectations and support
  • Drive strong outbound and inbound execution - ensure consistent standards across prospecting, sequencing, qualification, follow-up and handoffs
  • Identify and resolve regional blockers - surface issues across process, data, tooling, routing and skills, and work with the Global Head and cross-functional teams to address them
  • Partner with Sales and Marketing - strengthen meeting quality and pipeline conversion while ensuring EMEA & APJ SDR activity aligns with campaigns and ABM priorities
  • Feed EMEA insight into the global SDR organisation - share what is working, what isn't and where regional learnings should influence the wider SDR strategy


 

What we're looking for

  • Have 2+ years’ experience managing SDR or BDR teams in a B2B SaaS environment
  • Have a proven track record of delivering against pipeline and revenue targets through a Sales Development team
  • Have experience leading both outbound and inbound motions, with a strong understanding of what drives conversion across each
  • A coaching-first leadership style - you spend time with reps, listen to calls, run roleplays and actively develop capability
  • Have experience developing SDR talent, managing performance and creating clear pathways for progression
  • Have commercial acumen - you understand pipeline economics, conversion rates and the levers that influence SDR performance
  • Data-driven and operationally disciplined, with the ability to identify performance gaps and turn insight into action
  • Be comfortable working in a fast-paced, high-growth environment and bringing structure, energy and accountability to a team

job.title: AI Engineer - AI Verticals
job.description:
What you can expect

As an AI Engineer specializing in Agentic AI, you will develop intelligent agents that can autonomously perceive, reason, and act in dynamic environments as part of Zoom AI Companion (AIC).

Your work will directly impact the Zoom user experience by designing and implementing innovative algorithms and systems. These enhancements will improve workplace efficiency and customer engagement across Zoom Virtual Agent (ZVA), Zoom Customer Experience (ZCX) and Zoom Workplace, serving vertical domains like healthcare, education, banking, and insurance.


 

About the Team

We are part of the Zoom AI Vertical Organization, dedicated to enhancing the Zoom user experience in workplace and customer interactions. Our team of innovative thinkers is focused on creating the next generation of AI technologies that can autonomously understand, learn, and adapt to improve user engagement and satisfaction. We are seeking an AI engineer to join our team and contribute to our groundbreaking Agentic AI project.


 

Responsibilities

  • Designing and implementing backend orchestration layers between AI components within microservices, focusing on agent workflows and runtime operations.

  • Building scalable LLM-powered systems including RAG pipelines, tool-use workflows, and multi-step reasoning agents.

  • Building AI agents using frameworks like LangChain, Dify, OpenAI SDK or internal orchestration system through code (not no-code tools), ensuring proper agent flow implementation.

  • Developing integration between various AI components including LLM, RAG, TTS (Text-to-Speech), and ASR (Automatic Speech Recognition) systems.

  • Writing and optimizing prompts for AI agents, conduct integration testing, and ensure proper functionality of agent systems.

  • Collaborating with research and product engineering teams to implement agent-based solutions that enhance user experience across vertical domains.

What we’re looking for

  • Possess a Bachelor's in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Cognitive Science or related field, and 10+ years industry experience (or a Master's and 8+ years, or a PhD + 5 years).

  • Show an understanding of machine learning algorithms, neural networks, reinforcement learning, cognitive architectures, and multi-modality including speech and vision.

  • Exhibit development skills in programming languages such as Python, C++, or Java, and experience with AI frameworks and libraries (e.g., PyTorch).

  • Have familiarity with Multiple Agent architectures and experience in designing and implementing multi-agent systems.

  • Utilize problem-solving skills and the ability to think creatively and critically about complex problems.

  • Communicate and collaborate with the ability to work effectively in a team-oriented environment.

job.title: DevOps Engineer
job.description:
DevOps Engineer


What you can expect

We seek a DevOps Engineer to maintain, scale, and enhance reliable SaaS platforms operating in distributed, large-scale environments. This role emphasizes operational excellence, automation, observability, and performance to ensure service availability and scalability. Responsibilities include managing initiatives from start to finish, leading critical incident responses, and collaborating with engineering teams to implement lasting improvements benefiting customers directly.


About the Team

With eight specialized departments, the engineering team functions as a highly collaborative, diverse powerhouse. Each department mission is to deliver seamless and innovative communication solutions. These range from software development and machine learning to quality assurance teams that work to create and maintain Zoom's user-friendly interfaces and robust infrastructure. The team continues to push the boundaries of communication technology, bringing people together regardless of their physical distance.


Responsibilities

  • Operating, scaling, and continuously improving software-as-a-service production platforms across distributed environments.
  • Designing and implementing uninterrupted solutions to ensure continuous operation for services with an availability target of 99.999%.
  • Developing and maintaining disaster recovery strategies across data centers located in various regions.
  • Developing and maintaining automation, tools, and scripts to enhance deployment efficiency while minimizing manual tasks and improving overall operational workflows.
  • Implementing and improving monitoring, alerting, and observability ensures proactive identification and prevention of potential issues.
  • Owning system performance, availability, and scalability for services that directly engage with customers.
  • Analyzing system behavior and performance data to pinpoint bottlenecks and uncover optimization opportunities.
  • Leading incident response efforts, performing root cause analysis, and implementing lasting remediation measures to address identified issues effectively.

What we’re looking for

  • 6–10 years of experience supporting and operating SaaS production systems in DevOps or SRE roles
  • Design systems that are highly available and meet uptime targets as high as 99.999%.
  • Demonstrate expertise in designing and implementing disaster recovery strategies across multiple regions.
  • Demonstrate expertise managing distributed systems within production environments that directly serve customers.
  • Demonstrate expertise in handling incidents, managing on-call operations, and conducting thorough root cause analysis to address and resolve issues effectively.

job.title: IT Analyst
job.description:
What You Can Expect

As an IT Analyst II in our San Jose office, you are the go-to resource for employees, executives, and new hires navigating their technology: resolving issues quickly, managing the full device lifecycle, and ensuring every first day goes smoothly. The work spans hardware, software, identity management, endpoint security, and the very human skill of translating a frustrating problem into a clear path forward. This is a role for someone who wants to understand root causes, not just close tickets, and who finds genuine satisfaction in making technology invisible so the people around them can focus on their best work. This position requires on-site presence five (5) days per week at our San Jose, CA office. Remote or hybrid arrangements are not available for this role.


About the Team

Our IT team delivers reliable, people-first support across Zoom's San Jose offices, approaching every interaction with empathy and a drive to solve the root cause rather than just the symptom. We take pride in making technology invisible so that everyone around us can focus on their best work, and we bring curiosity and care to every ticket we close.


Responsibilities

  • Diagnose and resolve hardware, software, networking, and SaaS application issues across phone, email, and ticketing channels, maintaining SLA compliance and positive CSAT scores.
  • Deliver dedicated IT support to senior leaders and executives, including priority troubleshooting, device setup, and travel-ready configurations, exercising professionalism and discretion.
  • Support new hire onboarding by provisioning devices, configuring accounts, and leading orientation walkthroughs, while managing user lifecycle events including provisioning, role transitions, and offboarding across identity platforms and directories.
  • Manage the full device lifecycle for the San Jose office, covering receiving, imaging, inventorying, deploying, tracking, and decommissioning laptops, monitors, peripherals, and accessories, and coordinating hardware orders, RMA processes, and shipping logistics with IT Asset Management, Procurement, and Workplace teams.
  • Implement and support endpoint management initiatives including OS patching, software deployment, and vulnerability remediation aligned with security standards, while monitoring and troubleshooting office infrastructure including printers and network connectivity.
  • Maintain accurate knowledge base articles, troubleshooting runbooks, and procedural documentation, contributing to continuous improvement through change management processes.

What We're Looking For

  • Bachelor's degree in Science, Engineering, MIS, or equivalent experience, with 3+ years in IT support, helpdesk, or desktop engineering roles.
  • Proficiency supporting both macOS and Windows environments in a corporate setting.
  • Hands-on experience with ServiceNow or a comparable ITSM platform, working knowledge of Okta for user provisioning, MFA, and access management, and experience administering Atlassian Cloud including project configuration, permission schemes, and workflow customization.
  • Strong diagnostic skills across hardware, software, networking, and cloud/SaaS applications, with the ability to communicate clearly and patiently with non-technical users.
  • Ability to manage competing priorities across ticket queues, onboarding sessions, asset logistics, and ad-hoc requests simultaneously, with a customer-first ownership mindset.
  • Familiarity with Zoom products (Meetings, Phone, Team Chat, Rooms), comfort using and supporting AI-powered productivity tools, and foundational network troubleshooting skills including WiFi diagnostics and VLAN awareness.
  • Okta Certified Professional certification (held or in progress), experience in a high-growth technology environment, and the physical ability to lift and move IT equipment as part of regular asset management duties.

job.title: Head of Infrastructure and Employee Services
job.description:
What you can expect​

Evaluate system performance, identify improvements, and implement innovative solutions to enhance functionality and user experience. Advance IT capabilities to increase productivity, safeguard intellectual property, and collaborate with Product Engineering to improve Zoom products. Oversee a team of approximately 70 individuals across seven global locations, managing strategy, planning, and delivery of IT infrastructure and end-user services. Responsibilities include end-user services, network solutions, technical support, security policy implementation, product testing, engineering infrastructure support, and vendor coordination. The ideal individual combines technical expertise with business insight, demonstrating excellent communication, leadership, and organizational skills while effectively collaborating across teams in a dynamic environment.

About the Team

Zoom's Information Technology team is dedicated to delivering customer happiness, enhancing business efficiency, and fostering agility through innovation, data insights, and automation. Our impact is evident in seamless user experiences, streamlining processes, and supporting Zoom's growth in communication and collaboration.

Responsibilities

  • Leading a global team to oversee, operate, and support essential corporate IT services and product engineering labs, including Identity and Access Management (IAM). Managing EndPoint solutions, Unified Communications, Service operations, and multiple XaaS-based applications effectively.
  • Focusing on Infrastructure as Code while leveraging artificial intelligence and automating employee services to enhance efficiency and streamline processes effectively.
  • Identifying and driving strategic investments aimed at reducing technical debt effectively and efficiently.
  • Enabling Zoom-on-Zoom while collaborating with product teams to deliver essential input on feature gaps and product-related issues.
  • Analyzing business requirements to design and optimize system functionalities for improved operational efficiency and scalability.
  • Enhancing Zoom workforce productivity by creating and providing innovative workplace technologies and connectivity solutions for end users.
  • Establishing infrastructure portfolio governance and ensuring effective execution of cross-functionally prioritized initiatives outlined in the roadmap.
  • Maturing IT's role as Customer Zero for products, providing operator and end-user experience insights to support product development at Zoom.
  • Monitoring system performance and identifying opportunities for enhancements to maintain reliability and minimize downtime.

What we’re looking for:
Essential Requirements:

  • Hold qualifications in Computer Science, Engineering, MIS, or possess equivalent professional experience.
  • Bring 15 years of experience leading IT Infrastructure Technology and Operations, including 5 years in senior management at VP or Senior Director levels.
  • Manage extensive global IT teams within organizations exceeding 10,000 employees. Lead enterprise service support roles, overseeing multiple leaders in large-scale firms.
  • Demonstrate extensive expertise in planning, designing, and implementing scalable XaaS-based solutions and on-premise IT infrastructure with 24/7 global support services.
  • Demonstrate expertise in managing a worldwide IT infrastructure and support team using agile practices and Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) methodology.
  • Demonstrate expertise in AI/ML, GenAI solutions, and their application in Service Desk or IT support environments.
  • Gain practical experience in aligning infrastructure and operations with frameworks such as NIST, SOX, SOC, and other industry standards.
  • Demonstrate expertise in technologies like Identity and Access Management (Okta, SailPoint), operating systems (macOS, Windows, Linux), and Endpoint Management (Workspace One, Jamf, InTune, VDI). Utilize tools for Vulnerability Management (Qualys, Tenable), Unified Communications (Zoom, Google Workspace, Proofpoint, SendGrid), and Service Management (ServiceNow, Jira, PagerDuty). Apply security solutions (CrowdStrike, Digital Guardian) and Infrastructure-as-a-Service platforms (AWS, GCP).

job.title: Staff DevOps Engineer
job.description:
Immigration sponsorship is not available for this position

What you can expect

We are hiring a Staff DevOps/Site Reliability Engineer to ensure reliability, scalability, and operational excellence for our real-time communications platform. This platform supports audio/video conferencing, recording, and live-streaming functionalities. The position requires expertise in infrastructure engineering, global team collaboration, and cross-functional partnerships.

About the Team

This team manages essential meeting service operations at Zoom. They handle global, large-scale distributed systems and advance communication technology to connect individuals across physical distances.

Responsibilities

  • Ensuring reliability engineering and operations by owning the SLO/SLI framework for real-time services, defining, tracking, and improving latency, availability, jitter, and packet loss.
  • Leading incident response for critical outages across the real-time platform, coordinating across time zones and engineering disciplines.
  • Promoting a blameless postmortem culture and ensuring action items lead to measurable reliability enhancements.
  • Implementing chaos engineering and game day exercises to proactively identify failure modes before user impact occurs.
  • Building and evolving observability tools — dashboards, alerting systems, and distributed tracing — tailored for real-time media infrastructure challenges.
  • Serving as the architectural authority on deployment patterns, infrastructure design, and operational readiness for real-time services.
  • Reviewing and contributing to system design proposals, providing feedback on scalability, fault tolerance, and operational complexity.
  • Driving capacity planning, traffic modeling, and cost optimization strategies across globally distributed infrastructure.
  • Evaluating and recommending infrastructure tools, platforms, and vendors — including media servers, CDN providers, cloud-native services, and edge networking.
  • Ensuring consistent standards for CI/CD pipelines, deployment safety, and progressive rollout strategies across teams.
  • Acting as the primary SRE partner for multiple engineering teams building real-time features, attending planning sessions, and providing operational readiness guidance.
  • Collaborating closely with network engineering, security, product, and data teams to align on platform-wide reliability requirements.
  • Translating infrastructure constraints and reliability trade-offs into actionable recommendations for product leaders and engineering teams.
  • Establishing and advocating DevOps best practices — infrastructure-as-code, GitOps, automated testing, and deployment automation — across partner teams.
  • Guiding senior engineers on SRE principles, reliability patterns, and operational discipline.
  • Serving as a technical liaison between US-based and China/India-based engineering teams, bridging communication gaps and providing technical context.
  • Conducting architecture reviews, incident retrospectives, and planning sessions in English and Mandarin as appropriate.
  • Maintaining a flexible schedule to ensure meaningful overlap with teams in Beijing, Shanghai, Bangalore, and Hyderabad.
  • Building collaborative relationships across cultural and geographic boundaries, adapting communication styles to foster trust and alignment.
  • Ensuring engineering documentation, runbooks, and architectural decision records are accessible and understandable for global team members.

What we’re looking for

  • 10+ years in DevOps, SRE, or infrastructure engineering roles, with at least 3 years at a staff or principal level scope.

  • Have a proven track record owning reliability for large-scale, distributed, latency-sensitive systems in production

  • Have experience in supporting real-time or media-heavy platforms (video conferencing, live streaming, gaming, trading systems, or similar).

  • Demonstrate ability to lead cross-functional technical initiatives without direct authority, driving alignment across engineering, product, and operations.

  • Have conceptual and architectural understanding of real-time communication protocols: WebRTC, RTP/RTCP, TURN/STUN, SDP, and SFU/MCU topologies.

  • Have solid expertise in cloud infrastructure (AWS, GCP, or Azure) and container orchestration (Kubernetes, Helm, ArgoCD).

  • Demonstrate proficiency with infrastructure-as-code tooling: Terraform, Pulumi, or equivalent.

  • Have experience with observability stacks: Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, Jaeger, OpenTelemetry, or equivalent.

  • Have an understanding of networking fundamentals: BGP, anycast routing, DNS, load balancing, and CDN architecture.

  • Utilize CI/CD tools such as GitHub Actions, Jenkins, and Spinnaker to streamline workflows and improve deployment processes.

  • Implement deployment safety practices like canary releases, feature flags, and blue/green strategies to ensure reliable software delivery.

  • Demonstrate proficiency in Python, Bash, or Go for automation, tooling, and incident response without requiring advanced software development expertise.

  • Occasional weekend work may be required

  • Ability to work across the globe or multiple time zones

job.title: Sales Development Representative Manager
job.description:
What You Can Expect

As Sales Development Representative Manager for Workvivo's AMER and LATAM region, you will own the full performance and development of a regional SDR team operating across both outbound and inbound motions. This is a hands-on leadership role at a meaningful moment for Workvivo: with the recent launches of Seer and Workvivo HQ, the team has a compelling, expanded story to bring to enterprise CHROs, CTOs, and Internal Comms leaders across two high-growth markets. Day to day, you will build coaching culture, translate global strategy into regional execution, and partner closely with Sales and Marketing to ensure the team delivers consistent, high-quality pipeline. This is a hybrid position that requires on-site presence 3 days per week at our Boston, MA office. Remote arrangements are not available for this role.


About the Team

Workvivo, now part of Zoom, is an employee communications and insights platform serving mid-market and enterprise companies globally, with buyers that include CHROs, CTOs, CIOs, and Internal Comms Directors. Our AMER and LATAM SDR team operates a balanced motion: structured outbound sequencing into target accounts alongside managed inbound response, with a clear focus on pipeline quality over volume. The team runs within Zoom's worldwide network, giving you the backing and resources to build at scale while maintaining the pace and ambition of a high-growth product.


Responsibilities

  • Deliver against regional meeting, SQO, and pipeline targets by owning AMER and LATAM SDR performance, with clear focus on the inputs and behaviors that drive results
  • Translate global SDR strategy into effective regional execution, ensuring playbooks and programs are adopted consistently across AMER and LATAM
  • Build and sustain a daily coaching culture through call reviews, role-plays, 1:1s, and live feedback that continuously sharpens rep performance
  • Develop and retain SDR talent by identifying high performers, building individual development plans, and addressing performance gaps with clear expectations and support
  • Drive consistent outbound and inbound execution across prospecting, sequencing, qualification, follow-up, and handoffs
  • Identify and resolve regional blockers across process, data, tooling, routing, and skills, partnering with the Global Head and cross-functional teams to address them
  • Partner with Sales and Marketing to strengthen meeting quality and pipeline conversion, ensuring AMER and LATAM SDR activity aligns with campaigns and ABM priorities
  • Share regional learnings and insights with the global SDR organization to influence strategy and improve what is working across the wider team

What We're Looking For

  • 2+ years of experience managing SDR or BDR teams in a B2B SaaS environment, with a proven track record of delivering against pipeline, meeting, and revenue targets
  • Experience leading both outbound and inbound SDR motions, with a strong understanding of what drives conversion across each
  • Coaching-first leadership approach, with demonstrated experience listening to calls, running role-plays, and actively developing rep capability
  • Experience identifying high performers, managing performance gaps, and creating clear development pathways for SDR talent
  • Strong commercial acumen, including pipeline economics, conversion rates, and the data-driven levers that influence SDR performance
  • Effective cross-functional communicator and collaborator, with experience partnering with Sales, Marketing, and Enablement stakeholders
  • Comfortable operating in a fast-paced, high-growth environment and bringing structure, accountability, and energy to a team
  • 3 days per week in person in our Boston office.

Workvivo is an employee experience platform designed to amplify workplace culture and foster employee engagement, regardless of location. As part of Zoom, an intelligent collaboration platform, Workvivo aligns with Zoom's mission to prioritize people, enabling meaningful connections, modern collaboration, and driving innovation in businesses and individual interactions.

  • Demonstrate pipeline efficiency and contribution, reporting on pipeline per dollar and business impact metrics

  • Manage regional marketing budgets and report pipeline performance to senior leadership

As a Workday Extend Developer on Zoom's Enterprise Applications team, you'll work at the intersection of technical architecture and people-centered design, building the integrations and custom applications that keep our global workforce systems running seamlessly. You'll partner closely with People Experience and IT stakeholders, bringing deep Workday expertise to complex, high-impact challenges spanning the full HCM ecosystem. This is a role with real scope, where you'll help shape how enterprise technology operates at scale within a company that believes in building thoughtfully and shipping work that matters. job.title: Lead Site Reliability Engineer, Platforms
job.description:
What You Can Expect

As a Lead Staff Site Reliability Engineer, you will be one of the technical leads for our DevOps Platforms organization. This group is responsible for DevOps Platforms including cloud infrastructure, physical data center orchestration, critical security services, and our Zoom for Government (ZfG) environment. You will be an uber tech lead working across a broad area, defining projects and guiding work across various teams. Your scope of work is wide and you will have the opportunity to improve our datacenter kubernetes infrastructure, our cloud infrastructure, our security posture, and our operation of ZfG environments. Broadly speaking, you are an exemplary SRE and you will guide all of our teams toward SRE best practices (automation, monitoring, infrastructure as code, etc).

About the Team

The DevOps Platforms organization owns the full infrastructure stack: cloud infrastructure on AWS and OCI, physical data center orchestration, critical security services (identity, authentication, authorization), and Zoom's FedRAMP-rated federal environment, Zoom for Government (ZfG).

The team is currently working on one of the most technically interesting work in the org, hardening our security posture, and building the automation and reliability systems that underpin Zoom's global services. If you want broad visibility, real cross-team influence, and the chance to define how infrastructure gets built, this is the seat.

Responsibilities

  • Design and scale DevOps platform services including Kubernetes infrastructure, cloud systems, and compliance-ready environments
  • Define technical roadmaps and architectural direction for infrastructure automation and security
  • Partner with service teams to understand platform needs and deliver solutions that improve reliability and efficiency
  • Establish and advocate for SRE best practices including infrastructure as code, monitoring, and incident management
  • Mentor team members through design, implementation, and production deployment of complex systems

What We're Looking For

  • Bring 8+ years of SRE or DevOps experience building and operating production infrastructure at scale
  • Code proficiently in at least one programming language beyond scripting (e.g., Python, Go, Java)
  • Deploy and manage CI/CD pipelines using tools like Git, Jenkins, Argo CD, or JFrog
  • Operate cloud infrastructure on AWS, OCI, or similar platforms using Terraform and Kubernetes
  • Implement observability solutions with logging and monitoring tools such as ELK, Prometheus, or Grafana
  • Communicate complex technical concepts clearly to diverse audiences including security teams, senior leadership, and external auditors
  • Participate in on-call rotations and lead incident response to maintain system reliability
  • Hold a degree in Computer Science or related field, or equivalent practical experience
  • Hold US citizenship, or Greencard status

Preferred

  • Have experience with security from an SRE perspective
  • Have experience with Identity security (e.g. IAM, workload identity, zero trust) and tools (e.g. Teleport, Okta)
  • Have experience operating Government environments and understanding their compliance requirements
  • Have experience with system design and distributed computing at scale
  • Ability to speak Chinese/Mandarin is a plus, but not required

job.title: Manager of Platform DevOps
job.description:
What You Can Expect

You will be the leader of our Platforms DevOps team.  This team is responsible for Zoom’s Kubernetes clusters in both datacenters and clouds, as well as for our cloudops infrastructure.  The scope and mandate of the team are broad, and you will have significant opportunities to partner with teams across Engineering, DevOps/SRE, and Security. You'll drive projects that enable new features, improve infrastructure reliability and security, and reduce costs. Within the team, you'll manage technical ICs and continuously improve processes with automation, policy, and AI.

Broadly speaking, you are an exemplary SRE/DevOps leader with expertise running k8s, and knowledge of best practices for IaC, automation, monitoring, and security.  You also have experience communicating nuanced concepts to diverse audiences (e.g. both engineers and senior management). You can balance technical tradeoffs, and can adapt plans to deliver quickly on the most important goals for our customers and partners.

About the Team

We manage Zoom's Kubernetes and cloud operations infrastructure at scale. Our team collaborates across Engineering and Security to automate processes and optimize platform performance. We enable reliable, secure, and cost-effective infrastructure for Zoom's global services.

Responsibilities

  • Leading projects that automate infrastructure management and advance the team's Kubernetes and cloud capabilities

  • Identifying and executing cost optimization opportunities across cloud resources and infrastructure

  • Driving security improvements across cloud and Kubernetes assets in partnership with Security teams

  • Collaborating with partner teams and stakeholders to understand needs and build project roadmaps

  • Developing team members and optimizing work processes through mature software practices and continuous improvement

  • Have 5+ years of SRE or DevOps experience managing production infrastructure

  • Lead and develop technical teams with 3+ years of management experience

  • Have experience with at least one programming language, in addition to scripting languages 

  • Have experience with cloud providers (e.g. AWS, OCI) and cloud infrastructure technologies (e.g. Terraform, kubernetes)

  • Demonstrate experience managing Kubernetes from an SRE perspective in production environments

  • Have experience with best practices for Continuous Deployment, including CI/CD tools and version control systems (e.g. Git, Jenkins, Argo CD, JFrog artifactory)

Preferred

  • Have experience with logging and monitoring tools (e.g. ELK stack, Prometheus, Grafana)

job.title: Staff AI Engineer
job.description:
What You Can Expect

You'll design, implement, and own the inference systems that serve Zoom's AI models at production scale -- across real-time communication, vision, and language workloads. You'll be hands-on with kernel-level optimisation, inference framework internals, and production serving infrastructure, working closely with research and platform teams to push the boundary on latency, throughput, and cost.


About the Team

You will join a dynamic AI Infrastructure team focused on enabling high-performance AI across Zoom's products and services. The team builds the core systems that support model training, deployment, and inference at scale, driving innovation in areas such as real-time communication, computer vision, and natural language understanding.


Responsibilities

  • Design and build high-performance inference serving systems for large-scale transformer and multimodal models (including 100B+ and MoE architectures)
  • Implement and tune inference optimisations: speculative decoding, continuous batching, KV cache management, prefill/decode disaggregation, and quantisation (INT4/INT8/FP8)
  • Contribute to and customise inference frameworks (vLLM, TensorRT-LLM, SGLang, or equivalent) for Zoom's production requirements
  • Write and profile CUDA kernels and custom ops where framework-level optimisation is insufficient
  • Own end-to-end deployment: from model packaging and serving API design to latency SLO monitoring and incident response
  • Partner with research to translate model architecture changes into inference-efficient implementations
  • Drive technical design and set the bar for inference engineering practices across the team

What We're Looking For

  • A Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience
  • 5+ years of software engineering experience, with significant time spent on inference systems or ML infrastructure at production depth
  • Hands-on experience with at least one major inference framework: vLLM, TensorRT-LLM, SGLang, or ONNX Runtime (serving, not just export)
  • GPU programming experience: CUDA kernel development, memory optimisation, and profiling with Nsight or equivalent tools
  • Production experience serving LLMs or large vision models -- you've owned latency SLOs, debugged throughput regressions, and shipped optimisations that moved the needle
  • Depth in at least two of: speculative decoding, continuous batching, KV cache design, quantisation pipelines, prefill/decode disaggregation
  • Strong systems instincts in Python and C++; ability to read and modify framework internals

Preferred

  • Advanced degree (Master's or PhD) in a relevant technical field
  • Experience with MoE models or 100B+ parameter deployments
  • Familiarity with disaggregated serving architectures or multi-node inference
  • Background in compiler-level optimisation (XLA, Triton, or similar)

job.title: Senior Offensive AI Security Engineer
job.description:
What You Can Expect

This role sits at the intersection of offensive security and applied AI, focused on surfacing critical risks across Zoom's products, applications, services, and infrastructure before they become incidents. Day to day, you will combine deep target knowledge, threat analysis, and cutting edge models to form hypotheses about where complex systems are likely to fail, validate exploitability, and trace attack paths that standard testing would miss. This is not a vulnerability-scanning or prompt-engineering role: a strong hands-on research craft is the foundation, and success is measured by whether your findings change how Zoom understands its risk, not by finding volume. Research directions are chosen in collaboration with the Security Assurance teams (Offensive Security, Vulnerability Management, Bug Bounty, PSIRT), but most work is self-directed, with high autonomy and no predetermined outcome.


About the Team

Zoom's Offensive Security team conducts vulnerability research across products, applications, and infrastructure, concentrating on high-impact issues that escape standard secure development processes or wouldn't surface through routine testing. The team is actively evolving towards AI-native research, where models extend how much ground experienced security engineers can cover and how quickly, paired with real target knowledge, a sound research strategy, and rigorous verification.


Responsibilities

  • Leverage AI to conduct vulnerability research across Zoom's products, applications, services, and infrastructure, with a focus on high-impact issues, subtle vulnerabilities, confirmed exploitability, and attack paths that cross component and trust boundaries.
  • Use experience, threat analysis, architecture knowledge, source code, and observed system behavior to choose targets and guide investigations.
  • Apply frontier and open-weight models, agents, and other AI capabilities across the research lifecycle: reconnaissance, code analysis, hypothesis generation, exploit development, and verification.
  • Design and tune research harnesses that give models the right context, tools, execution environments, and feedback to investigate real targets.
  • Develop custom tooling, including analysis utilities, fuzzers, agents, test harnesses, proofs of concept, and full exploits, when it helps answer the research question.
  • Convert promising model output into defensible security evidence: reproduce findings, rule out false claims, establish preconditions, and distinguish a possible weakness from a demonstrated vulnerability with real impact.
  • Improve the reliability and reach of AI-driven research by tackling false positives, false negatives, context limits, nondeterminism, and reproducibility.
  • Work directly with Engineering and Product Security to communicate findings, support remediation, surface related risks, and verify fixes.
  • Share tools, techniques, and lessons learned so Security Assurance and the broader Security org can enhance their processes through the use of AI.

What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years of hands-on vulnerability research, offensive security, application security, or penetration testing, with a demonstrated track record of choosing targets, forming and revising hypotheses, and establishing exploitability and impact in complex software or production systems.
  • Hands-on experience running offensive workflows with frontier and open-weight models, including model selection where refusal behavior would otherwise block legitimate exploit development.
  • Experience assessing the quality of AI-driven research processes, including identifying false positives, missed vulnerabilities, unstable results, and reproducibility gaps, as well as sound judgment on agent architecture trade-offs: when constrained, orchestrated pipelines deliver reproducible results and when open-ended tool-using agents are worth the nondeterminism.
  • Deep technical expertise in at least one security domain: web applications and APIs, Java applications, cloud or service infrastructure, client software, operating systems, or reverse engineering.
  • Strong programming and debugging skills: ability to read unfamiliar code, build research tooling, write proofs of concept, and trace behavior across system boundaries.
  • Strong intuition for attack surfaces, trust boundaries, exploitability, and security impact, combined with the persistence to work independently on open-ended research with no guaranteed path or outcome.
  • Ability to communicate findings clearly to both technical and nontechnical audiences, covering what the evidence shows, what remains uncertain, and why it matters.

job.title: Scale Campaigns & ABM Manager - Workvivo
job.description:
What you can expect

Workvivo is investing in a scaled account based marketing motion and is seeking someone to own it end to end. This role connects marketing, SDR, and sales teams. The position involves transforming account insights into actionable strategies by identifying accounts, building data foundations, and collaborating with SDR and AE teams.

It requires expertise in guiding SDR and AE leaders on account prioritization. Candidates with experience managing tiered strategies and distinguishing between activity and pipeline will thrive in this role. The focus is on delivering impactful and timely initiatives that drive success across targeted accounts.

About the Team

This role is part of the Global Field and Strategic Events team within Growth and Demand Generation. It focuses on account-based marketing strategies. Responsibilities include executing personalized programs for top US accounts, targeted programs for account clusters, and broader initiatives combining events, digital, and field efforts.

The target audience includes enterprise leaders such as CHROs, CIOs, and Internal Communications professionals. The role emphasizes creating impactful marketing motions to engage key stakeholders and scale efforts effectively across various segments, ensuring alignment with strategic goals and priorities.

Responsibilities

  • Managing Workvivo’s tiered ABM motion involves 1:1 for specific strategic accounts, 1:few for account clusters, and 1:many for programmatic engagement at scale.

  • Building and maintaining the account scoring and intent framework determines the appropriate tier placement and timing for account transitions.

  • Designing and managing multi-channel campaigns that integrate outbound, paid, and content efforts, ensuring accounts experience a unified approach rather than fragmented interactions.

  • Collaborating directly with SDR leaders to convert account priorities into structured sequencing, cadence, and outreach strategies.

  • Partnering directly with AE teams on account planning, defining shared transfer criteria, and ensuring joint accountability for pipeline within target accounts.

  • Managing the enrichment and intent data stack while overseeing associated vendor relationships.

  • Reporting on ABM performance involves using account-level metrics like engagement, penetration, and pipeline influenced, rather than focusing solely on activity volume.

  • Collaborating with Marketing Ops and RevOps ensures accurate account and contact data, as scaled processes quickly fail when the information is incorrect. Adapting the motion by region, recognizing that EMEA, LATAM, and APJ will not run the same play at the same pace.

What we’re looking for

  • Demonstrate experience using an intent or account scoring platform such as 6sense, Demandbase, or similar within a production environment.

  • Demonstrate experience with enrichment and data orchestration tools (Clay, ZoomInfo, Clearbit, or similar) and how to connect them cleanly into a CRM.

  • Demonstrate proficiency in Salesforce and a sequencing tool like Outreach, including understanding how account and contact data transfers between platforms.

  • Demonstrate over six years of experience developing and managing tiered account-based marketing strategies effectively.

  • Direct experience as an SDR or working alongside SDR and AE teams on the same accounts, with shared ownership of outcomes.

  • Comfort presenting account level and pipeline metrics to stakeholders in clear, accessible language.

  • Operate effectively across various regions or markets.

  • Develop an ABM function from an initial or unstructured phase into a well-organized, tiered approach.

  • Possess experience in SaaS or B2B technology within an organization utilizing a distributed or hybrid sales structure.

The Channel Account Manager enhances sales revenue by building relationships with partners in Saudi Arabia They collaborate with partners on marketing plans, training, and needs. They drive growth through channel programs and align with objectives while maintaining customer satisfaction.

The Zoom sales team is a dynamic force driving the company's success. Through strategic partnerships and a customer-centric approach, they play a pivotal role in expanding Zoom's global presence and ensuring businesses harness the full potential of virtual collaboration.
 

What we’re looking for

  • Have 2+ years experience in managing partnerships in Unified Communications/ Cloud /Telephony space.
  • Be able to develop and execute sales strategies for Partner programs & sales enablement
  • Experience with SaaS Resellers in Saudi Arabia; fluent Arabic speaker required
  • Have a deep understanding of the Partner ecosystem
  • Possess excellent communication and negotiation skills to effectively collaborate with partners and internal stakeholders.

  • Have collaborated with the Alliances that drive the Zoom ecosystem. i.e Poly, Dten, NEAT, Oracle, Ribbon, Jabra, Verint.

يُعزز مدير حسابات القنوات إيرادات المبيعات من خلال بناء علاقات متينة مع الشركاء في المملكة العربية السعودية. ويتعاون مع الشركاء في وضع خطط التسويق والتدريب وتلبية احتياجاتهم. كما يُساهم في دفع عجلة النمو من خلال برامج القنوات، ويتوافق مع الأهداف مع الحفاظ على رضا العملاء.

As an SMB Account Executive in Tokyo, you will own a growing portfolio of small business clients across Japan, guiding organizations with up to 50 employees toward Zoom Workplace solutions that fit how they work. You will bring a consultative approach to every client conversation, partnering closely with cross-functional teams to build the kind of trust that turns first engagements into long-term relationships. This is a front-line role with direct visibility into Zoom’s Japan go-to-market strategy, offering meaningful scope and a clear path to grow your career alongside our business. This is a hybrid position that requires on-site presence 2 days per week at our Tokyo office.

About the Team

Our Japan sales team is a dedicated group focused on bringing Zoom’s communications solutions to businesses across the country. We operate with a customer-first mindset, building strategic partnerships that help clients unlock the full value of virtual collaboration. Every team member plays a meaningful part in expanding Zoom’s presence in the Japanese market.

job.title: Senior Solutions Engineer
job.description:
What You Can Expect

You will serve as the lead technical advocate for our customers, helping them understand and leverage Zoom's architectural advantages while partnering closely with our Upmarket Enterprise and Majors AE teams across the West. This is a role for a well-rounded, technically credible SE who brings broad knowledge across the full UCaaS stack, not just a single product line.

This is a high-visibility, high-impact role supporting some of the most complex accounts in the country: enterprise-scale technology companies that demand sophisticated, multi-product solution design.

This role is for a forward-thinking UCaaS generalist with a passion for technology, a customer-first mindset, and a genuine drive to deliver happiness through transformative AI solutions.

About the Team

Supporting Upmarket West accounts, our Solutions Engineering team acts as the strategic and technical backbone for complex enterprise deal cycles. We partner closely with Account Executives to architect full-platform solutions, articulate Zoom’s competitive advantages, and deliver happiness to our clients.

Responsibilities

  • Partner closely with Enterprise and Majors AEs to drive technical sales engagements across the full Zoom platform—including Meetings, Phone, Contact Center, Rooms, and AI-powered solutions.
  • Lead technical discovery, solution design, custom demos, and proofs of concept (POCs) tailored to address complex enterprise collaboration challenges.
  • Serve as the primary technical advocate for our clients, translating customer requirements into product recommendations and driving feature requests internally with Product and Engineering.
  • Articulate Zoom’s architectural advantages, enterprise AI use cases, and broader vision to decision-makers ranging from technical practitioners to executive leadership.
  • Gather market intelligence and competitive insights from field engagements to help refine sales strategies and inform internal roadmaps.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with AEs, product managers, and specialists to manage RFPs/RFQs, remove technical blockers, and accelerate deal cycles.

What We're Looking For

  • 8+ years of solutions engineering experience supporting enterprise-level customers in technical pre-sales, with a strong understanding of the sales cycle and ability to drive urgency at the right moments.
  • Strong working knowledge across the full UCaaS stack—SaaS collaboration, cloud voice, contact center, video, and unified communications—with ability to hit the ground running; generalist profile strongly preferred over narrow specialization.
  • Highly proficient in presenting complex technical solutions, from traditional voice systems to modern cloud platforms, with hands-on familiarity with API integrations, networking protocols, security best practices, and cloud infrastructure (AWS, Azure, GCP).
  • A genuine passion for AI: not just awareness of the trends, but real use cases, hands-on experience, and the ability to speak to its impact on the modern workforce with conviction.
  • Natural rapport-builder with strong business acumen and executive presence: effective with AEs, executives, and technical stakeholders at every level.

job.description:
What You Can Expect

As Premier Support Manager, you will lead a team of Technical Account Managers at the forefront of Zoom’s most strategic enterprise relationships, directly shaping customer outcomes and the long-term success of our Premier Support portfolio. Day to day, you will develop your team, define performance goals, and serve as an executive escalation point for complex customer situations, working in close partnership with Customer Success, Service Engineering, and Sales. This role is a strong fit for someone who leads with data, builds accountability with care, and brings genuine commitment to developing people alongside delivering results. You will report to senior leadership within the Global Premier Support organisation. This is a hybrid position at our London office.


About the Team

The Premier Support team delivers high-touch technical account management for Zoom’s most strategic enterprise customers, helping them realise the full value of Zoom Workplace. The team works at the intersection of technical expertise and relationship management, partnering with Sales, Customer Success, and Engineering to resolve complex challenges and drive proactive outcomes. As a key pillar of Zoom’s customer experience strategy, the team plays a meaningful role in retention, expansion, and satisfaction across the Premier portfolio.


Responsibilities

  • Lead, coach, and develop a team of Technical Account Managers, building the skills and competencies needed to deliver outstanding Premier Support experiences.
  • Recruit, onboard, and grow talent within the TAM team, ensuring all business processes and quality standards are upheld to the highest level.
  • Define and drive team KPIs, quarterly goals, and strategic initiatives aligned to the broader Premier Services program.
  • Analyze team performance data and process metrics to proactively identify risk factors, growth opportunities, and areas for continuous improvement.
  • Serve as an executive-level escalation point for complex customer situations, partnering with Customer Success Managers, Escalations, and Service Engineering to drive timely resolution.
  • Partner with Account Executives and Customer Success Managers to strengthen customer relationships and support the retention and growth of the Premier Service portfolio.
  • Identify team underperformance and manage structured improvement plans with appropriate senior support.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional leaders to deliver data-driven decisions that enhance team processes and strengthen the Premier Services program.

job.title: Technical Consultant
job.description:
What You Can Expect

You are the anchor of long-term technical success for some of Zoom's most complex enterprise contact center deployments. You own the ongoing technical relationship across a portfolio of MSO accounts running Zoom Contact Center and Zoom Virtual Agent, driving continuous optimization, resolving escalations, and ensuring customers extract measurable value from the platform. You work at the intersection of customer advocacy, platform expertise, and operational excellence, partnering closely with Engineering, Product, and Customer Success to move quickly on what matters most. Candidates without hands-on cloud contact center experience or conversational AI platform expertise will not be considered for this role.


About the Team

Zoom’s Managed Services Operations (MSO) team is the long-term success engine for Zoom’s enterprise and premier contact center customers. We stay engaged after implementation, ensuring complex Zoom Contact Center and Zoom Virtual Agent environments remain optimized, resilient, and aligned to each customer’s evolving business goals. Our team operates at the intersection of product, engineering, and customer success, and our work directly shapes how enterprise organizations experience and grow with Zoom’s contact center platform.


Responsibilities

  • Own the ongoing technical relationship for a portfolio of enterprise MSO accounts running Zoom Contact Center and Zoom Virtual Agent, serving as the primary technical advisor across configuration, optimization, and escalation management.
  • Lead recurring cadence calls, monthly and quarterly business reviews, and ad-hoc technical sessions with customer stakeholders, translating business objectives into actionable Zoom Contact Center and Zoom Virtual Agent strategies.
  • Execute day-two configurations including flow updates, queue management, skill-based routing, IVR modifications, and Zoom Virtual Agent conversation design changes across voice, chat, video, and SMS engagement channels.
  • Design and refine Zoom Virtual Agent bots, including intent training, NLP tuning, API and webhook integrations with platforms such as Salesforce and ServiceNow, and OAuth-based authentication flows.
  • Analyze call analytics dashboards and CX metrics to identify trends, surface quality issues, and recommend data-driven improvements aligned to each customer’s business outcomes.
  • Manage Tier 2/3 escalation triage for assigned accounts, coordinating with Zoom Support, Engineering, and Product teams to resolve critical incidents with defined timelines and thorough root-cause documentation.
  • Advocate internally for customer needs, driving feature requests, escalating product gaps, and maintaining awareness of platform releases and known issues that may affect customer environments.
  • Maintain detailed account documentation including meeting notes, configuration records, escalation logs, and runbooks, and contribute to team knowledge bases, playbooks, and AI-assisted automation tooling.
  • Partner with TAMs, CSMs, and Account Executives to deliver a unified customer experience, and actively participate in MSO Ops Weekly, team standups, and cross-functional syncs.

What We’re Looking For

  • 5+ years of hands-on experience with cloud contact center platforms, with Zoom Contact Center strongly preferred; equivalent experience with Genesys, NICE, or Five9 accepted.
  • Demonstrated experience with conversational AI and virtual agent platforms, including bot design, intent management, NLP configuration, and API integrations.
  • Strong command of contact center fundamentals: ACD, IVR/IVA, skill-based routing, workforce management concepts, and omnichannel engagement.
  • Working knowledge of REST APIs, OAuth 2.0, webhooks, JavaScript, and CRM/ITSM integrations including Salesforce and ServiceNow.
  • Proficiency in call analytics interpretation and CX dashboard analysis, with the ability to translate data into clear, customer-facing recommendations.
  • Excellent communication skills across technical and executive audiences, with the ability to operate independently in a remote, distributed environment across time zones.
  • Experience in a managed services, professional services, or TAM/CSM capacity with ongoing account ownership responsibility; scripting and automation skills (Python, JavaScript) and certifications in Zoom, CCNA Collaboration, or cloud contact center platforms are a plus.

job.title: Head of India
job.description:
What you can expect

We're seeking a senior sales leader to own Zoom's India business and drive its next phase of growth. Reporting to the Head of APAC, you'll lead a high-performing team spanning enterprise, upmarket, mid-market, and SMB segments — with full revenue accountability for one of Zoom's most strategically significant markets.You will shape Zoom's go-to-market strategy for India, build organisational capability, and play a pivotal role in Zoom's broader APAC growth story.

About the Team

The India sales team operates in one of the most dynamic and high-potential markets in the world. Working closely with strategic partners, channel ecosystems, and customers, the team unlocks growth opportunities and positions Zoom as the trusted platform for workplace productivity and customer experience. As Head of India Sales, you will lead this team and define what winning looks like in this market.

What we’re looking for

job.title: Zoom Phone Sales Specialist
job.description:
What You Can Expect

In this role, you will work at the intersection of consultative selling and cloud communications, helping UK&I organisations move beyond legacy telephony to an intelligent, AI-first experience with Zoom Phone. You will partner closely with Account Executives and channel partners to drive net-new and upsell opportunities across the Mid-Market and Enterprise segments, supporting the full sales cycle from discovery through to close. This is a high-impact specialist sales position where your deep UCaaS expertise shapes how customers understand and adopt the future of business communications. This is a hybrid position that requires on-site presence 2 days per week at our London, UK office.

About the Team

The Zoom Phone sales team sits at the heart of Zoom Workplace, helping organisations replace legacy telephony with a cloud-native, AI-first communications platform. We work alongside Account Executives and channel partners with a consultative, customer-centric approach, showing businesses how voice, meetings, chat, and AI come together in a single solution. Our mission is to grow Zoom’s presence across UK&I by demonstrating that modern telephony is about unlocking the intelligence within every conversation.

Responsibilities

  • Partner with Account Executives and channel partners to identify, develop, and close net-new and upsell Zoom Phone opportunities across Mid-Market and Enterprise segments

  • Design and execute product and solution training programmes for Sales Engineers and channel partners

  • Identify new ways to develop Zoom’s UCaaS go-to-market strategy across the UK&I region

job.description:

We are building pipeline at scale in a market that's rapidly maturing. As a Commercial BDR, you will identify buyers, test strategies, and drive revenue growth.


This role requires proactive engagement, continuous improvement, and ownership of activities. You will directly shape our market approach within the Commercial segment.

Common Room is an AI platform that consolidates buyer signals into one view, enabling teams to identify targets, craft messages, and determine timing effectively.


Supported by over $50M in funding from investors like Greylock, Index, and Madrona, Common Room is now part of Zoom Revenue Accelerator (ZRA).

job.title: Principal, Global PX Operations Lead
job.description:
What You Can Expect

As a Global People Experience Operations Lead, you serve as the operational engine behind Zoom’s People function and the right hand to the Global Head of PX Operations. You will turn strategy into shipped process, working systems, and metrics that hold up in front of executives, with genuine ownership over platform design, service architecture, and automation delivery. Your work centers on rebuilding Zoom’s ServiceNow HR Service Delivery platform, architecting a Tier 0 through Tier 3 service model, and embedding AI and automation into people processes that reach every Zoomie worldwide. Impact here is measured in concrete outputs: SLA compression, deflection rate, first-contact resolution, hours returned to the business, and ROI on every solution you ship.


About the Team

PX Operations is the shared services and operational backbone of Zoom’s People function, delivering across a matrixed, multi-region model spanning India, the Philippines, Mexico, and other global markets. The team supports Zoom’s overall business strategy by helping identify, hire, onboard, develop, and reward Zoomies while continuously improving the employee experience. Working here means partnering across a global community of coordinators, specialists, and CoE stakeholders to build a People function that scales with the business.


Responsibilities

  • Own the end-to-end ServiceNow HR Service Delivery platform rebuild, covering catalog architecture, case taxonomy, routing logic, knowledge management, approval workflows, and integrations with Workday and adjacent systems.
  • Architect and operationalize a Tier 0 through Tier 3 service model, building self-service capabilities, operating standards, escalation protocols, and governance frameworks across the global PX Ops community.
  • Design, deploy, and measure AI-powered and automated workflows across employee support, onboarding, offboarding, and talent acquisition operations, applying systems thinking to eliminate waste and compress cycle times.
  • Define and own the PX Operations reporting layer, including metrics frameworks, executive dashboards, and cadenced reporting on SLA compliance, deflection rates, first-contact resolution, CSAT, and ROI.
  • Drive global process harmonization across regional teams, establishing governance for AI and automation deployment that includes model validation, bias safeguards, audit trails, and compliance documentation.
  • Partner with CoEs, Payroll, Legal, IT, and Engineering on cross-functional escalations and platform integrations, representing PX Operations at senior stakeholder forums and serving as deputy to the Global Head of PX Operations.
  • Coach and enable the global PX Ops coordinator community on process discipline, tooling, and data literacy, raising capability across the offshore and onshore delivery model.


What We’re Looking For

  • 8 to 10 or more years of experience in HR/People Operations, shared services, HR technology, or transformation, with demonstrable ownership of operational delivery at enterprise scale within a multi-tier, multi-region organization.
  • Deep, hands-on ServiceNow expertise (HRSD strongly preferred), including at least one end-to-end platform rebuild or major redesign you led or co-led, plus strong Workday proficiency and experience with HRIS-to-case-management integration.
  • Proven track record designing and operating Tier 0 through Tier 3 service models, with documented results across SLA attainment, first-contact resolution, deflection rate, and CSAT.
  • Demonstrated AI and automation delivery experience with quantified outcomes, such as hours saved, volume deflected, cycle time reduced, or cost avoided.
  • Advanced data analysis skills and the ability to build and present executive-ready dashboards and stakeholder reporting, with fluency in translating analysis into clear recommendations.
  • Process improvement expertise through systems thinking methodologies such as Value Stream Mapping, root cause analysis, and Lean Six Sigma (Green Belt or above preferred), combined with experience driving global process harmonization.
  • Bachelor’s degree in a related field, or equivalent business experience, and the ability to handle highly sensitive and confidential information with absolute discretion across multiple regulatory environments.

Minimum:

$126,500.00

Maximum:

$276,700.00

Diagnose and resolve complex technical issues for Zoom's Elite customers. You'll partner with engineering and cross-functional teams using advanced troubleshooting tools. Your work directly protects customer experience on Zoom's platform.

We support Elite customers across the full spectrum of UC challenges. Our team owns issues end-to-end, collaborating across engineering and services. We exist to keep Zoom's most critical customers running.

job.title: Workplace Coordinator, Customer Engagement
job.description:
Workplace Coordinator, Customer Engagement

What You Can Expect

In this role, you will serve as the face of Zoom’s Tokyo office, creating meaningful experiences for customers, employees, and visitors at one of our most important customer-facing sites in the region. You will lead day-to-day operations while supporting high-impact customer events and Experience Center programming, ensuring every touchpoint reflects Zoom’s standard for world-class service. Beyond office management, you will play an active part in the planning and execution of Zoom’s new Tokyo office relocation, collaborating with contractors, internal stakeholders, and a global Real Estate and Workplace Services team spanning markets from Singapore to San Jose. Full professional fluency in Japanese and English is required for this role. This position requires on-site presence five (5) days per week at our Tokyo, Japan office. Remote or hybrid arrangements are not available for this role.

About the Team

The Real Estate and Workplace Services team at Zoom drives the physical environments and workplace experiences that enable Zoom’s global workforce to do their best work. Operating across major offices in the Asia Pacific region and beyond, this team ensures every Zoom location is a welcoming, functional, and connected space for Zoomies and customers alike. As a member of the Tokyo team, you will contribute to a growing APAC presence with close ties to counterparts in Singapore, Sydney, Mumbai, and the broader global organization.

Responsibilities

  • Operate the Tokyo office end-to-end, managing facilities, vendor relationships, preventative maintenance, badge access, shipping and receiving, and catering coordination to maintain a safe, welcoming environment for all employees and guests.
  • Lead on-site health and safety protocols, including emergency procedures and evacuation planning, as an active member of Zoom’s local health and safety team.
  • Deliver exceptional customer and visitor experiences by welcoming guests, pre-registering attendees, and serving as the primary on-site point of contact during all customer visits and Experience Center events.
  • Support the planning, coordination, and execution of customer-facing and internal events, covering room setup, AV readiness, catering logistics, and post-event wrap-up.
  • Manage virtual reception across the APAC region and collaborate with regional Workplace Coordinators in Singapore, Sydney, and Mumbai to align on standards, share best practices, and support cross-regional initiatives.
  • Coordinate Zoom’s Tokyo office relocation by serving as the on-the-ground liaison for construction and fit-out activities, tracking milestones, flagging issues, managing FF&E procurement, and supporting Day 1 readiness planning.
  • Partner with administrative and onboarding teams to support new hire workspace setup, badge issuance, office orientation, vendor contract records, purchase order tracking, and budget reporting.

What We’re Looking For

  • 2 or more years of experience in workplace coordination, office management, facilities, events, or an executive briefing or customer engagement environment, with a demonstrated track record of delivering high-quality employee and customer experiences.
  • Experience supporting or coordinating customer-facing events, VIP visits, or executive programming, with strong attention to logistics, setup, and real-time problem-solving.
  • Stakeholder and vendor management experience, including familiarity with preventative maintenance processes and health and safety protocols.
  • Experience with internal facility ticketing systems and a proven ability to manage workloads within established SLAs; office relocation or build-out experience is a plus.
  • Organized, self-directed approach to work with the ability to manage competing priorities and drive projects to completion with minimal direction.
  • Full professional fluency in Japanese and English (written and spoken) is required.
  • Proficiency in workplace tools including the Zoom Workplace platform, Microsoft Office or Google Workspace, and facility management systems.

What you can expect:

We are seeking a highly skilled and motivated Machine Learning Engineer to join our team and play a key role in developing and maintaining our knowledge graph service. As a Machine Learning Engineer specializing in knowledge graphs, you will work closely with cross-functional teams to design, implement, and optimize algorithms and models that enable efficient representation, integration, and retrieval of structured and unstructured data.

Responsibilities:  

  • Architect and optimize large-scale Machine Learning workflows to process structured and unstructured data for knowledge graphs and search services; Architect and optimize large-scale Machine Learning workflows to process structured and unstructured data for knowledge graphs and search services;
  • Deploy, monitor, and maintain machine learning models (LLMs and agentic workflows) in a microservice environment using Docker, Kubernetes (AWS EKS), and internal platforms (ZCP);

  • Maintain comprehensive documentation for all AI search systems, workflows, and services using Confluence, Zoom Docs, and LucidChart;
  • Develop business logic for routing requests to Machine Learning models and managing feature stores;

  • Develop performance metrics, monitoring systems, and optimizations for AI search pipelines to ensure scalability, efficiency, and low latency;
  • Develop and maintain AI-driven search and ranking algorithms for enterprise-scale information retrieval and RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) systems;

  • 3 years of experience maintaining comprehensive documentation for all AI search systems, workflows, and services using Confluence, Zoom Docs, and LucidChart;
